title: General Virtual Assistant for Real Estate — (Philippines Only)
description:
## Open to applicants currently based in the Philippines only



At this time, we are only accepting applications from candidates who are currently based in the Philippines. Applications from outside the Philippines will not be considered. We appreciate your interest and understanding.



Smartland (Real Estate) is seeking a highly organized **Virtual Assistant** who thrives on productivity and excels at managing multiple tasks with discipline, initiative, and innovation.



If you love checklists, calendars, staying organized, and making sure tasks are completed promptly, you may be a great fit for our dynamic team.



## English Communication Requirement



Candidates must have **strong English communication skills**, with a **minimum expected level of B2; C1 is preferred**.



You should be able to communicate clearly and professionally in both written and spoken English, understand instructions accurately, and communicate effectively with clients, prospects, and internal team members.



**An English proficiency test result is not required at the time of application.** However, Smartland may request proof of English proficiency **later in the hiring process, including after the interview**, if needed.



English proficiency will be evaluated throughout the screening and interview process.



**Please do not apply if you do not feel confident communicating professionally in English at a B2 level or higher.**



## Responsibilities



* Handle HubSpot chat inquiries and engage with potential leads.

* Manage property listings across various platforms.

* Create and manage Facebook advertisements to generate leads.

* Post property listings on Craigslist, Apartments.com, Google, and other platforms.

* Share and promote posts using relevant hashtags to increase visibility.

* Maintain clear, professional, and effective communication with clients and prospects.

* Handle inquiries from prospects promptly and professionally.

* Use AI tools to improve efficiency and productivity in daily tasks.

* Submit daily and weekly reports using Microsoft Excel.

* AppFolio experience is a plus.

* Demonstrate strong multitasking skills and the ability to manage multiple platforms simultaneously.



## Qualifications



* Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar administrative role.

* **Strong English communication skills — minimum expected level: B2; C1 preferred.**

* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

* Strong time management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Google Sheets and Trello; familiarity with AppFolio is advantageous.

* Knowledge of AI tools and the ability to use them effectively.

* Self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently.

* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

* **Must be currently based in the Philippines.**



## Attendance & Reliability Expectations



Reliability and attendance are essential for success in this role. We are looking for candidates who can consistently report to work on time, remain available during their scheduled hours, and communicate promptly if an unexpected emergency arises.



Attendance and dependability are especially important during the probationary period, as this is when we evaluate overall fit and commitment. If you are unable to consistently meet these expectations, this position may not be the right fit.



## Our Core Values



**Respect:** Foster a respectful and inclusive workplace.

**Innovation:** Embrace creative solutions and continuous improvement.

**Persistence:** Demonstrate determination to overcome challenges.

**Discipline:** Maintain high standards of organization and accountability.

title: Remote Solar Engineer / Tech Support
description:
Job Overview



We’re BigBattery, a fast-growing brand focused on providing top-tier battery storage and energy solutions. Whether our customers are building an off-grid cabin, a home backup system, or a full-scale solar array, we help them get the right products, expert guidance, and reliable energy systems. We are seeking a detail-obsessed, fast-moving Solar PV Specialist to own the full technical function of our system configurations. Your mission will be to interpret customer requirements, size custom setups, and validate component compatibility so that every kit is fully optimized for BigBattery products and completely install-ready.



Key Responsibilities



-Solar System Design: Own the full lifecycle of solar design, including load calculations, system sizing, and layout configurations for off-grid and hybrid systems.

-BOM & Compatibility: Build complete, install-ready Bills of Materials (BOMs), ensuring flawless integration between customer inverters, charge controllers, and BigBattery units.

-System Standardization: Develop and maintain standardized system templates (e.g., 5kW, 10kW kits) to simplify the ordering process for recurring customer use cases.

-Technical Support: Act as the company’s technical truth source, providing advanced troubleshooting and integration assistance for customers via
, live chat, or phone.



Requirements



-2–5+ years of hands-on solar PV system design experience, with a heavy emphasis on off-grid or hybrid energy storage setups.

-Deep technical understanding of lithium-ion battery integration, inverters, charge controllers, and proper system wiring/fusing.

-Proficiency with solar design software (such as Aurora Solar, HelioScope, or AutoCAD) and advanced Google Sheets skills for component tracking.

-Fluent written and verbal English communication skills for direct customer interaction and clear documentation.



Schedule & Compensation



-Hours: Full-time (8 hours/day), completely available during 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday.

-Salary: $1,000/month base salary + performance-based output bonuses.

title: Scheduler / Office Coordinator
description:
Scheduler / Office Coordinator



SLB In-Home Care — pediatric in-home nursing (Georgia, USA) · Remote (Philippines-based)

Work setup: Remote · Full-time, long-term · Must work U.S. Eastern business hours (families & nurses are in Georgia)



Pay: $640–$960 / month (equivalent to ~$4–$6/hour at ~160 hours/month), depending on experience



Reports to: Owners · works daily with the nurses, recruiter, and families



About the role:

SLB In-Home Care provides skilled nursing and personal-care support to medically fragile children across Georgia. We're

looking for a sharp, dependable Scheduler / Office Coordinator to run our day-to-day scheduling and family/nurse

communication desk.

You'll work alongside our automation — the system prepares the schedules, flags the changes, logs the calls, and builds

the tickets. Your job is the human side: review and confirm what the system prepares, make the calls, keep families and

nurses in the loop, and stay on top of the moving pieces so nothing falls through the cracks.



What you'll do:



* Scheduling: maintain the weekly nurse/caregiver schedules; review and commit schedule changes the system drafts;

keep the calendar accurate.



* Supervisory visits: schedule required nurse supervisory (SV) visits on cadence and send the reminders.



* Calls & texts: handle inbound and outbound calls and texts with families and nurses — return missed calls promptly,

confirm appointments, answer scheduling questions.



* Ticketing: own the request queue — log every family/nurse request, follow up, and close it out.



* Timesheet coordination: chase missing shift notes and timesheets and flag discrepancies (the system helps surface

these).



* Documentation: keep everything organized and up to date in our systems (CareBravo, ClickUp).



!!! Important — this is a phone-heavy, English-first role. You'll be talking to American families and nurses every day. Excellent

spoken and written English is required and will be tested in the interview. Dependability during U.S. Eastern hours is non-

negotiable.



Requirements:



Must have:

*Excellent spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional on the phone

*Strong organization and attention to detail; able to juggle many moving pieces without dropping any

*Reliable and available during U.S. Eastern business hours

*Comfortable working alongside software/AI — reviewing and confirming what the system prepares, not fighting it

*Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset



Preferred:

*Home-care, home-health, or medical scheduling experience

*Experience with scheduling / EVV software (CareBravo, or similar)

*Experience with ClickUp or a similar ticketing / task tool



Bonus:

*Experience working with a U.S. company or in U.S. healthcare / Medicaid

*Customer-service or call-center background





How to apply:

Please send your résumé and a short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself (so we can hear your English),

plus brief answers to:

1. Describe your scheduling or coordination experience.

2. Do you have any home-care, healthcare, or U.S.-company experience?

3. What tools have you used — scheduling software, EVV, ClickUp, ticketing?

4. Tell us about a time you managed a lot of moving pieces or last-minute changes. How did you stay on top of it?

5. Your available hours in U.S. Eastern time, and your internet speed.





!!!! Only candidates with strong English and real coordination experience will be considered. This is a long-term role with room

to grow into an operations lead.

title: Video Editor | D2C Performance Ad Creative for Meta Ads
description:
UGC Video Editor | Performance Ad Creative for Meta Ads



Remote | Full-Time Contractor | Long-Term Role | Fast-Paced Agency



We are Dominate Next, a performance marketing agency based in Scotland. We help direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands across the UK, US and Australia scale through Meta ads and performance creative.



We are hiring a UGC Video Editor who can turn raw creator footage into scroll-stopping ads that convert.



This is not a “make it pretty” role. This is not a cinematic editing role. This is not a YouTube or podcast editing role.



This role is about pacing, clarity, rhythm, retention and making ads feel native to TikTok, Reels and Meta feeds while still driving action.



You will work closely with our creative strategy team, who will provide briefs, raw creator footage, examples, hooks, angles and direction. Your job is to turn that into strong short-form ads that can be tested in real Meta ad accounts.



What you will do

- Edit short-form 
 ads for
 and Instagram.

- Create around 15 short-form videos per week.

- Build multiple versions quickly using different hooks, pacing, clips, and structures.

- Add native-feeling captions, on-screen text, simple motion, sound design and light effects.

- Improve raw creator footage so the final ad feels sharp, clear and engaging.

- Keep edits aligned to the creative brief and client brand guidelines.

- Take feedback quickly and make revisions without ego.

- Repurpose strong footage into new variations and angles.

- Work closely with our creative strategists, designers and paid social team.



What we need from you



Must-haves

- Very proficient in CapCut. This is our preferred editing workflow.

- Strong understanding of UGC, Reels, and paid social ad editing.

- Strong sense of rhythm, flow, pacing and retention.

- Sharp attention to detail, especially captions, cuts, framing, audio levelling and spelling.

- Strong written English.

- At least 1 year of experience editing D2C UGC and paid social ads.

- Reliable and fast internet connection.

- Able to follow a brief closely while still bringing your own editing judgement.



Big plus

- You have edited direct-response ecommerce ads for Meta.

- You understand performance creative basics.

- You know how to make the first 3 seconds stronger.

- You can identify when a video feels too slow, too scripted or too polished.

- You can repurpose one piece of footage into several different ad variations.

- You have experience with beauty, wellness, food, drink, home, lifestyle or supplement brands.

- You have basic knowledge of motion graphics and AI.



This role is probably right for you if

- You enjoy editing short-form ads that are designed to perform.

- You understand that a good ad needs more than clean visuals.

- You care about pacing, hooks, clarity and viewer retention.

- You can take feedback and improve quickly.

- You like working in a fast-paced creative team.

- You want a stable, long-term role where your edits are tested in live ad accounts.



This role is probably not right for you if

- You mainly edit YouTube videos, podcasts or cinematic reels.

- You only want to make aesthetic lifestyle videos.

- You do not have examples of UGC, TikTok, Reels, or paid social ad edits.

- You struggle with captions, spelling or written English.

- You need very detailed instructions for every small edit.

- You do not like fast feedback or revisions.

- You are not interested in e-commerce, Meta ads, or direct response creative.



Working setup

- Full-time remote contractor role.

- 37.5 hours per week.

- Long-term position if you perform well.

- You will have some overlap with UK working hours.

- You will be part of a small, high-performance creative team.

- You will receive direct feedback and clear creative standards.

- You will invoice us monthly as an independent contractor. You are responsible for your own tax and BIR registration in the Philippines.



Pay

- $700 to $800 USD per month depending on experience, speed and quality.



How to apply - Applications that do not follow this will be ignored.



Please include:

- Your portfolio with your best UGC, TikTok, Reels or paid social ad edits.

- A short introduction (Loom video or equivalent) explaining your editing experience.

- Your internet speed test.

- Answers to the application questions below.

- Add the word “TARTAN” at the end of your application so we know you read the full post.



Do not send generic reels, cinematic edits, YouTube videos, podcasts or long-form work unless you also include paid social or UGC ad examples.



If you do not have UGC / performance ad samples, this is not the right role.



Questions to answer in your application

1. How long have you been editing short-form videos, UGC or paid social ads?

2. What editing software do you use?

3. Send 3 examples of short-form ads or UGC videos you edited. For each one, briefly explain what your role was.

4. What makes a UGC ad feel native to TikTok or Reels instead of looking like a polished brand ad?

5. If a video feels slow in the first 5 seconds, what are 3 things you could do to improve it?

6. Are you comfortable creating multiple variations from the same raw footage?

7. Are you comfortable working with UK overlap?



If you want a stable, long-term editing role where your work gets tested in real ad accounts and you can level up quickly, we would love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper / Accountant — US Tax Prep & IRS Audit Substantiation (Part-Time, Project-Based)
description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper / Accountant — US Tax Prep & IRS Audit Substantiation (Part-Time, Project-Based)



About the role:

I'm a US-based small business owner (fitness coaching, LLC) and self-employed individual looking for a highly competent bookkeeper/accountant with US accounting experience (personal and business) to help me get current on my taxes and support an active IRS audit. You will work alongside my US tax representative (an Enrolled Agent), who handles all official filings and sign-off. Your job is the legwork: organizing, matching, and substantiating.



Project 1 (priority): 2025 Tax Return Preparation



Compile and organize all 2025 receipts and income records, split cleanly into two separate books: (1) Anthony Ogogo personal, (2) Ogogo Fitness Elite Coaching (LLC, taxed as disregarded entity/self-employed).

Match every expense to its corresponding bank or credit card statement line. A receipt alone is not sufficient; every deduction needs a paired payment record.

Calculate the home office deduction (business-use square footage as a percentage of total home square footage).

This return is currently overdue (was due April), so speed matters — the goal is to get this filing-ready as quickly as possible to minimize penalties and interest.



Project 2: 2023 IRS Audit Substantiation



The IRS disallowed three expense categories in full (Other Expenses, Travel, Legal & Professional Services) due to insufficient substantiation. This is now under appeal.

Go through all 2023 receipts and match each to bank/card statements using the same two-document standard as above.

Organize everything so it's ready to hand to my tax representative for the appeals hearing.

This is not time-critical (IRS appeals backlog is 8–24 months) but should be picked up once the 2025 return is filing-ready.



Ongoing role (after both projects are complete):



Become my regular bookkeeper — ongoing receipt organization, expense categorization, and keeping personal and business finances tidy and separated going forward.



Who you are:



Strong US bookkeeping/accounting experience, ideally with both personal and small-business (LLC/self-employed) returns.

Meticulous, detail-oriented, comfortable reconciling receipts against bank statements line by line.

Comfortable using your own preferred bookkeeping system/tools; I can share the records I already have organized.

Able to work independently and escalate only what needs a decision.

Bonus: experience supporting an IRS audit or substantiation process.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word AUDIT — applications that don't include this will not be reviewed.

Record a personalized 3-minute Loom video addressing me, Anthony Ogogo, directly by name, explaining your relevant experience and specifically why you're a strong fit for this role. If you cannot record a personalized Loom, please do not apply. Generic or templated Looms will be rejected.

Include any relevant experience with US tax prep, bookkeeping, or audit support.



Terms: Part-time, project-based to start (2025 return and 2023 audit substantiation), with potential to move into an ongoing part-time bookkeeping role. Async work is fine, no time zone requirement.

title: Retention Operations Assistant - Remote
description:
Full-Time | 1099 Contractor | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



We’re looking for a sharp, highly organized Retention Operations Assistant to support our Head of Client Retention at a fast-growing U.S.-based technology company.



This is a great role for someone who likes keeping a lot of moving pieces organized, naturally follows through, communicates exceptionally well, and gets satisfaction from making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



This is not a highly technical position, and you do not need previous AI experience. Prior experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Customer Service Representative, Account Coordinator, or similar role is preferred - but we care just as much about how you think, communicate, prioritize, and take ownership.



What You'll Be Doing:



You'll work closely with our Head of Retention to keep client accounts, follow-ups, and internal action items organized and moving forward.



Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:



Reviewing client and internal communications each morning and identifying what needs attention

Creating a clear, prioritized daily rundown for the Head of Retention

Monitoring open client issues and making sure next steps, statuses, and follow-ups stay current

Following up with internal team members on outstanding action items and deadlines

Following up with clients by phone, text,
, and Slack when information, scheduling, or a response is needed

Coordinating calendars and helping schedule client meetings with the appropriate team members

Preparing account information and context before important client conversations

Researching account history when a client issue is escalated, including reviewing messages, notes, timelines, recordings, and other available information

Summarizing complicated situations into clear, useful updates so leadership can quickly understand what happened and make a decision

Running basic test calls and documenting anything that needs further review

Drafting clear, professional client
s

Keeping our internal retention systems accurate and up to date

Catching overdue or missing items before they become bigger problems

Making sure open loops actually get closed



You will not be responsible for making major client retention decisions, negotiating refunds, or independently resolving complex escalations. Your job is to gather the right information, keep things moving, and make sure the Head of Retention has what she needs to make those decisions.



The Person We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you're the type of person who sees five open items and immediately starts figuring out what matters most, who owns each one, and what needs to happen next.



We'd love someone who is:



Extremely organized - you can manage multiple clients, deadlines, and follow-ups without losing track of details

Proactive - you look for the answer before immediately asking someone else

Resourceful - if you don't know where something is, your instinct is to figure out where to look

Strong at prioritization - you understand that not every task is equally urgent

Excellent at follow-through - when someone says they'll have something done tomorrow, you remember to check tomorrow

A critical thinker - you don't simply copy information; you try to understand what actually happened

Concise - you can turn 20 messages into the five sentences your manager actually needs

Calm and professional - especially when communicating with a frustrated client

Comfortable holding people accountable - you're willing to politely follow up until something is completed

A strong written and verbal English communicator

Quick to learn new systems and processes

Reliable and consistent



We don't expect you to know everything on day one. We do expect you to learn quickly, take good notes, use the resources you're given, and become increasingly self-sufficient as you're trained.



Requirements



You must:



Be available Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Be comfortable working as a 1099 independent contractor

Have a reliable, high-speed internet connection

Have a reliable computer and professional remote-work setup

Have strong spoken and written English

Be comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients and team members

Be comfortable using tools such as Slack, CRM systems, calendars,
, and Zoom

Be comfortable making outbound client follow-up calls when necessary

Be comfortable being on camera for internal Zoom meetings

Maintain a professional appearance and environment while on camera



Prior experience in executive assistance, operations, customer service, account management, or client success is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate.



This Role Probably Isn't for You If...



We want to be transparent about the environment you'll be joining.



If you need your manager to tell you what to do next throughout the day, this probably won't be the right fit.



If something is missing, we want your first instinct to be:



“Let me see if I can figure this out.”



If someone owes you an answer, we want you comfortable following up.



If ten things happen at once, we want you thinking about priority, rather than simply doing whichever task you saw first.



And if you discover something that requires a leadership decision, we want you to gather the facts, organize them clearly, and escalate it—not guess.



You'll receive training, processes, and support. The goal is for you to become someone your manager can depend on, not someone she has to constantly manage.



Compensation & Opportunity



$400–$600 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



This is a full-time remote contractor position with consistent Monday–Friday hours. We're looking for someone who wants stability, enjoys becoming excellent at their role, and would like the opportunity to grow alongside a growing company.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume for consideration.



We're intentionally selective about this role because the person we hire will become an important part of our day-to-day operations.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short video questionnaire so we can learn more about how you communicate, think, and approach your work.



Candidates who perform well on the questionnaire will then receive a link to schedule an interview with our team.



If you're organized, resourceful, thoughtful, and the person people naturally rely on to keep things moving—we'd love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer - AI & Native Ads (DTC E-commerce)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce brand in the health and wellness space, and we’re looking for a highly skilled Graphic Designer who specializes in high-performing native-style ads for Meta/Facebook.



We are not looking for a traditional static ad designer focused on polished, branded graphics.



We need someone who understands how to create raw, native, “ugly” ads that blend naturally into the feed, create curiosity, stop the scroll, and generate clicks.



To be considered, you must include the word “RDM” in the title of your application.



About the Role



This role is not about making ads look pretty.



It’s about creating native creatives that sell.



You’ll be responsible for creating native ad images on demand whenever new concepts, angles, hooks, or copy need visuals. This is not a role where you’ll be expected to produce a fixed number of images every single day.



At the beginning, you can expect approximately 5–10 hours of work per week. As our creative output increases and we require more work from you, we plan to increase your workload and raise your monthly pay accordingly.



You’ll work closely with our team to turn hooks, angles, concepts, headlines, and full native ad copy into visuals designed specifically for direct-response performance.



A major part of the role is being able to read and understand the copy yourself rather than simply waiting to be told exactly what image to make.



We expect you to understand:



* What the copy is trying to communicate

* What stage of awareness the customer is in

* Who the target avatar is

* What emotions or problems the copy is tapping into

* What type of image would best complement the copy

* What visual would create the most curiosity and click intent

* What would feel believable and native to that specific audience



You should be able to take a piece of native ad copy, understand the marketing strategy behind it, and independently determine the most appropriate visual direction for the target customer.



If you understand direct-response marketing, customer psychology, native advertising, the DTC space, and curiosity-driven design, this role is for you.



What You’ll Be Designing



Your primary focus will be native-style image ads, including:



* Raw, unpolished, feed-blending image ads

* Screenshot-style creatives

* Notes-app-style creatives

* Text-message / WhatsApp-style creatives

* Article / advertorial-style creatives

* News-style and editorial-style creatives

* Headline-driven clickbait ads

* UGC-style still images

* AI-generated lifestyle and scenario imagery

* Curiosity-driven images that intentionally feel organic

* Hook-first scroll stoppers designed specifically for cold traffic



The goal is not to make every creative look professionally designed.



The goal is to make every creative feel native, clickable, believable, and aligned with the copy and target avatar.



What You’ll Own



Native Creative Execution



Create attention-grabbing native ad images whenever new creative concepts are ready to launch.



You will receive ad copy, hooks, angles, references, or briefs from our team and will be expected to turn them into the most strategically appropriate native visuals.



Sometimes we may provide a very clear visual direction.



Other times, we expect you to read the copy, understand the customer, and come up with the visual concept yourself.



The ideal person does not just ask:



> “What image do you want me to make?”



They think:



> “What image would make this exact person stop scrolling and want to know more?”



Marketing & Avatar Understanding



We expect you to have a strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and direct response.



You should be able to identify the core:



* Hook

* Problem

* Desire

* Emotional driver

* Mechanism

* Curiosity gap

* Target customer

* Stage of awareness



You should then translate that understanding into a visual that makes sense for the copy.



For example, a native image targeting a 55-year-old woman dealing with a specific health concern should not necessarily use the same aesthetic, imagery, or visual language as an ad targeting a 25-year-old beauty customer.



The creative needs to feel like it was made for the person seeing it.



DTC Creative Research



We expect you to have a strong understanding of the DTC e-commerce advertising space and actively keep up with what is currently working.



At least once per week, we expect you to spend time reviewing Meta Ads Library and studying the creative output of successful DTC brands.



This includes looking at:



* What native ad formats brands are currently pushing

* What types of images are appearing repeatedly

* How brands are making their ads blend into the feed

* New screenshot, UGC, editorial, testimonial, and advertorial formats

* How brands are visualizing different customer problems

* What visual styles appear to be getting scaled

* New trends that could be adapted to our own brands



We can provide you with an initial list of brands to regularly monitor, but we expect you to take ownership of your learning.



You should be naturally curious and willing to discover additional brands, competitors, and creative trends yourself rather than limiting your research to the exact references we provide.



We want someone who is constantly asking:



> “What are strong DTC brands doing right now, and what can I learn from it?”



Continuous Improvement



We expect your native ad output to improve over time.



As you study more brands, see more performance data, work across more avatars, and understand our markets better, your ability to choose the right visuals should become increasingly strategic.



You should actively build your own understanding of:



* Winning native formats

* Visual patterns

* Different customer avatars

* Different markets

* Click psychology

* DTC creative trends

* What makes certain native visuals feel believable

* What makes an image feel too much like an advertisement



We value designers who are eager to learn and improve, not people who simply complete assigned tasks and stop thinking about the craft.



AI Integration



Use AI tools extensively where they help improve speed, variety, and creative quality.



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Generate realistic people and environments

* Create lifestyle imagery

* Produce unusual or curiosity-driven visual concepts

* Modify existing images

* Generate multiple visual directions quickly

* Build base assets that can then be edited into finished native creatives



You should be able to take an AI-generated image and turn it into something that feels believable, native, and commercially usable, rather than obviously AI-generated.



Testing & Iteration



When required, create multiple variations around a concept for testing across:



* Images

* Visual angles

* Layouts

* Native formats

* Headline presentation

* Framing

* Levels of polish

* Different ways of representing the same core idea



As performance data comes back, we may ask you to create further iterations around winning concepts.



You should be comfortable using performance feedback to improve future creative decisions.



Systematization



When a native format performs well, we want you to help turn it into a repeatable creative framework that can be adapted across new hooks, avatars, markets, and products.



Platform Optimization



Ensure creatives are properly optimized for Meta and other paid-social placements, including maintaining required dimensions and aspect ratios such as 1:1 when specified.



Who You Are



* 1+ year of experience creating direct-response ads for DTC e-commerce brands

* Available for approximately 5–10 hours per week initially

* Interested in growing into a larger role as our creative needs increase

* Strong understanding of native advertising and direct-response design

* Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and customer psychology

* Able to read native ad copy and independently determine the strongest visual direction

* Understands how creative should change depending on the target avatar

* Familiar with the DTC e-commerce advertising ecosystem

* Comfortable regularly researching creatives through Meta Ads Library

* Naturally curious about what successful brands and advertisers are testing

* Proactively looks for new brands, trends, and examples to learn from

* Understands exactly what makes an image feel clickable in a feed environment

* Comfortable deliberately creating ads that feel raw, organic, or imperfect

* Highly skilled with AI image-generation and editing tools

* Experienced with Photoshop, Figma, Canva, or similar design software

* Strong image manipulation and compositing ability

* Able to take a concept and execute it independently with minimal direction

* Fast, reliable, and organized

* Excellent communicator with a track record of meeting deadlines

* Understands that native/ugly ≠ lazy — it is a deliberate performance strategy

* More interested in whether an ad converts than whether it wins a design award



Bonus — Nice to Have



* Experience using AI tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, ChatGPT image generation, Flux, or similar

* Previous experience specifically creating native Meta/Facebook ads

* Background working with health, beauty, wellness, or supplement brands

* Experience designing creatives for advertorial funnels

* Familiarity with Meta ad performance metrics and creative feedback loops

* Understanding of CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR, and ROAS

* Basic understanding of direct-response copywriting

* Experience identifying and iterating on winning creative patterns

* Experience conducting competitor and creative research through Meta Ads Library



You’ll Thrive Here If…



* You believe good design = design that converts

* You understand why native ads can outperform polished brand creatives

* You naturally think about why someone would stop scrolling and click

* You enjoy understanding the strategy and psychology behind the copy you’re designing for

* You’re capable of coming up with your own visual concepts rather than needing every creative completely mapped out for you

* You regularly study what other DTC brands are doing

* You actively look for new creative trends instead of waiting for someone else to show them to you

* You enjoy learning about different customers, markets, and avatars

* You don’t get emotionally attached to designs

* You’re comfortable killing losing concepts and iterating on winners

* You understand that sometimes a raw screenshot or simple native image will outperform a beautifully designed advertisement

* You dislike unnecessary over-design

* You want your work to have a measurable impact on revenue

* You want the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the company grows



Workload & Growth



This role will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with native ads created on demand based on our current creative needs.



We are looking for someone we can work with long term, not simply a freelancer for occasional one-off tasks.



As our brands and creative operation continue to grow, we expect the amount of work available to increase.



When we require a larger commitment from you, we will increase your monthly compensation to reflect the additional workload and responsibility.



The ideal person can eventually develop from someone executing native visuals into someone who deeply understands our customers, identifies strong visual concepts independently, spots emerging creative trends, and contributes to the broader creative strategy.



Growth Path



Native Ads Designer → Senior Native Ads Designer → Lead Designer → Creative Strategist



To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume / CV

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples specifically showing native, ugly, direct-response, or feed-blending advertising

4. Examples demonstrating your ability to use AI-generated imagery in commercial creatives

5. If available, examples of ads you created that actually performed, including relevant performance metrics

6. A short explanation of how you would read a piece of native ad copy and d
 what image should accompany it

7. A short explanation of how you currently research and keep up with DTC creative trends



Important



Include “RDM” in the title of your application or your application will not be considered.



Skill Requirements



Native Ads Creation · Direct Response Marketing · Graphic Design · Creative Research · DTC E-commerce · AI Image Generation · Meta Ads Library · Customer Avatar Research · Meta Ads Creative · Photoshop / Figma

We are hiring a full-time Commercial Real Estate Underwriting Analyst to support active financing assignments from initial review through closing.

s

Your primary responsibility will be analyzing properties for our acquisitions team, determining accurate ARVs (After Repair Values), and calculating Maximum Allowable Offers (MAOs) using our company's underwriting criteria.



This is an important role within our acquisitions operation. Our agents will rely on your analysis to determine what we can pay for properties, so accuracy and speed are extremely important.



Responsibilities

Run comparable sales ("comps") on residential properties

Determine accurate After Repair Values (ARV)

Review property condition and estimate appropriate repair ranges

Calculate MAO using our company's underwriting criteria

Select and document the best comparable properties

Identify when a property is difficult to comp or requires additional review

Return completed underwriting to acquisition agents quickly

Maintain accurate records of analyzed properties

Communicate with our acquisitions team through Slack

Update our CRM and/or Google Sheets as needed

Help improve our underwriting process as you learn our markets



Ideal Candidate

We are specifically looking for someone with previous experience working for a U.S. real estate wholesaler, investor, flipper, or acquisitions team.



You should already understand:

ARV

Comparable sales

MAO

Wholesale real estate

Fix-and-flip investing

Basic rehab/repair estimates

How property condition affects value

How to identify good vs. bad comps

Experience using tools such as Privy, Zillow, Redfin, MLS, or similar real estate platforms is a major plus.



You should also be:

Extremely detail-oriented

Good with numbers

Fast without sacrificing accuracy

Comfortable making judgment calls

Able to explain why you selected specific comps

Reliable during agreed working hours

Comfortable communicating with a U.S.-based team

Fluent in written and spoken English



Schedule

We are initially looking for approximately 20 per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position.

You will need meaningful overlap with U.S. Mountain Time business hours so our acquisition agents can receive underwriting quickly while speaking with sellers.



Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience.

We are willing to pay more for someone who has strong existing experience underwriting wholesale or fix-and-flip properties and can demonstrate that they know how to comp properties accurately.

This is intended to be a long-term position with room to grow as our company expands.

title: GoHighLevel Expert – Webinar Automation & Complex Workflow Specialist
description:
We run a high volume of **webinars and in-person workshops**, and we're looking for a true **GoHighLevel expert** to help us build, optimize, troubleshoot, and scale our automation infrastructure.



This role is now primarily focused on **GoHighLevel**, not Zapier.



**Webinar automation experience is a must.** We need someone who understands how to build sophisticated webinar registration, reminder, attendance, follow-up, and conversion workflows inside GHL and integrate them reliably with external webinar platforms such as Demio.



Our goal is to use **GHL's native automation capabilities wherever possible**, while using Zapier, webhooks, APIs, or other tools only when necessary.



What You'll Work On



You'll be responsible for building and improving automations such as:



* Webinar registration and confirmation workflows

* Workshop registration workflows

*
 and SMS reminder sequences

* Webinar attendance/no-show follow-ups

* Post-webinar nurture campaigns

* Consultation booking and reminder sequences

* Lead nurturing and re-engagement

* Pipeline and opportunity automations

* Tags, triggers, custom fields, and segmentation

* Conditional logic and branching workflows

* Calendar and appointment automations

* Internal notifications and task assignments

* Lead-source and campaign tracking

* Complex multi-step workflows

* Demio and other third-party integrations

* Webhooks, Zapier, and API-based integrations when necessary



Webinar Experience Is Required



You should understand the **entire webinar lifecycle**, not simply how to connect a registration form.



We want someone who can think through:



**Registration → Confirmation → Reminders → Webinar → Attended/No-Show → Follow-Up → Consultation → Nurture**



You should know how to make sure the correct contacts receive the correct communications based on their behavior.



GoHighLevel Expertise



We're looking for someone with **advanced, hands-on GHL experience** who can:



* Build complex workflows from scratch

* Troubleshoot existing workflows

* Identify duplicate triggers and contacts entering workflows incorrectly

* Prevent automations from firing multiple times

* Build advanced conditional logic

* Optimize workflows for reliability and scalability

* Determine when something should remain inside GHL versus using Zapier

* Integrate GHL with webinar and other third-party platforms

* Audit an existing GHL account and recommend improvements



You’re a Strong Fit If You Have



* **Expert-level GoHighLevel experience**

* **Strong webinar automation experience**

* Experience building complex GHL workflows

* Experience integrating GHL with webinar platforms

* Strong knowledge of webhooks and APIs

* Zapier experience

* Experience diagnosing broken or inefficient automations

* Ability to understand the business objective and design the automation—not simply follow step-by-step instructions

* Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills



We're especially interested in someone who can look at a process and say:



**“You don't need Zapier for this. We can accomplish it more efficiently inside GoHighLevel.”**



To Apply



Please skip the generic proposal.



Tell us briefly:



1. How many years you've worked extensively with GoHighLevel.

2. Describe a **complex GHL automation** you've personally built.

3. Describe your experience building **webinar registration, reminder, attendance/no-show, and follow-up workflows**.

4. Which webinar platforms you've integrated with GHL.

5. Give an example of an automation problem you diagnosed and how you fixed it.

6. Explain when you would use **GHL native workflows vs. Zapier/webhooks/API**.



Include the word **“lighthouse”** in your proposal so we know you've read the entire posting. **Proposals without it will not be reviewed.**



This can begin as a project-based role, but **there is an opportunity for ongoing work** for the right person as we continue expanding our GoHighLevel infrastructure.

title: Inside Sales Agent (Real Estate)
description:
PropZap — Building the Future of Real Estate in North America



PropZap is building a next-generation real estate platform designed to expand across North America.

We are pioneers in how modern real estate companies should be built — powered by strong systems, smart technology, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency.



We're building with intention.

With structure.

With technology at the core.

With performance that compounds over time.



Our goal is to create a brand that sets the standard. A company that leads. A platform built to scale intelligently and sustainably across markets.



And for the right person, this isn't just a job inside that company.

It's a front-row seat to its growth.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Role: Inside Sales Agent 

Location: Remote

Shift: Aligned with Canada MST

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: To Be Discussed, plus bonuses on closed deals



We believe great people build great companies. If you can consistently turn qualified leads into happy, ready clients, we are willing to offer premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close. Strong performers who show up and follow through will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You



Most roles like this bury you in cold outreach and rejection before you ever get to do the part you're actually good at. Here, you're not selling anyone on an idea — every inbound lead has already chosen PropZap before you even pick up the phone. That means your time and energy go toward actually helping people, not convincing them.



This role also isn't a dead end. It's one of the most important seats in the company — every client's journey passes through you first, which means your work directly shapes whether the business grows. And PropZap has real plans to expand into new markets across North America — being part of this team now means being part of building the systems and standards that carry us there.



That kind of visibility and impact is rare this early in a role, and it comes with a real path forward: as the team grows, this becomes a Team Lead position, overseeing other consultants instead of just working your own list.



And because your work is tied so directly to results, your compensation reflects that — premium pay, plus bonuses when your clients actually close. This is a ground-floor seat inside a company built to scale, and the people who join early and perform will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Be Doing



- Build genuine rapport with every client from the very first conversation, so they feel supported and confident right away

- Meet inbound leads who've already booked a scheduled consultation and were already qualified by an appointment setter before they ever reach you — they know who we are, they're expecting your call, and there's no cold pitch involved

- Reach out to past leads who inquired before but went quiet — real outbound work, but reintroducing a genuine opportunity to someone who's already shown interest, not cold-calling a total stranger

- Guide them toward getting pre-approved, whether through their own broker or ours

- Help them create an account on our proprietary home search platform

- Walk them through setting their price range, preferred areas, and property criteria so their search actually matches what they want

- Show them how to book their own showings through our platform, coordinating with them along the way

- Follow up consistently on where they're at with their pre-approval, their search, and showings — checking in until they're ready for the next step

- Hand them off to their agent once pre-approval is complete and they're set up on the platform — clean and complete, with nothing left for the agent to chase down

- Keep our proprietary system updated with every conversation and status change, so nothing falls through the cracks

- Give every client a smooth, seamless experience from their very first call through to the moment they're ready to be connected to an agent



NOTE: Responsibilities in this role may evolve over time based on the company's needs as we grow.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Who This Is Perfect For



- Someone who's naturally good at building rapport quickly, and can make a client feel confident and taken care of from the very first call

- Someone who's comfortable coordinating several moving pieces for one client at a time — pre-approval, search setup, showings — without losing track of any of them

- Someone who's tech-savvy and picks up new software quickly, since you'll be working across both our client-facing platform and our own internal system

- Someone who's a genuine team player — happy to support agents, ask for help when needed, and pitch in wherever the team needs it as we grow together

- Someone who wants real stability with real upside, not just another grind

- Someone who takes pride in their own numbers and doesn't need to be micromanaged to hit them

- Experience in sales, appointment setting, lead qualification, or account management

- Strong, friendly phone presence

- Comfortable working inside software tools and digital platforms

- Organized enough to follow up consistently without being reminded

- Real estate experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — basic familiarity with how buying or selling works is enough



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Gain



- Premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close

- Long-term stability inside a company built for where real estate is heading, not where it's been

- Real tools and a real process behind you — our proprietary platform and internal system are built specifically to support this role, so you're never guessing

- A genuine team around you — people who support each other and grow together as the company scales

- A clear path toward a Team Lead role as the team grows

- The chance to grow with the company as we expand into new markets across North America



Imagine being two or three years into a company that's expanded across multiple markets — knowing you were there building real relationships with clients from day one, right alongside a team that grew right along with you.



--------------------------------------------------------------

How to Apply



Send the following to:

title: Teaching Assistant
description:
Remote - Teaching Assistant to work with a college instructor to update his online business courses. The main goal of this gig or part-time job is to redesign the online course modules so they are student-user-friendly and compliant with the Americans with Disabilities Act for students who may be visually impaired.  In the US, the Americans with Disabilities Act requires course materials to be "accessible" for students who are visually impaired. For example, the course content would need to describe all pictures on the online course platform, called CANVAS, so a screen reader that blind students use can read the image description. Similar functions are available in PowerPoint and through ADOBE PDF, where you can edit the file so a reader can read the description to a visually impaired student using tools to read the file or CANVAS page.

This gig or part-time job is expected to last about 16 weeks, at the least, with about (average) 5 hours a week of work. This gig may become a long-term part-time teaching assistant position.

 Guidance will be provided weekly so you can update and edit modules each week.

Some Experience in Education and Online Courses

Experience as a Teacher's Assistant

title: SEO Specialist
description:
We are seeking an SEO Specialist with a technical focus to join our team. This role is vital for implementing and managing tracking pixels, creating website pages and content, conducting technical SEO audits, and ensuring seamless data integrity across all digital channels. The ideal candidate has strong technical expertise with tools like Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Bing Webmaster Tools, and is adept at optimizing websites for user experience and search engine visibility. Experience with platforms like WordPress, Squarespace, Webﬂow, and Shopify is a plus. This position involves optimizing both eCommerce and B2B service/software websites to improve their rankings.



Responsibilities:



Technical Setup and Management:

● Implement and manage tracking pixels, schema markups, and data layers on websites.

● Update and maintain Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and other relevant tools.

● Conduct website audits to ensure accurate data tracking and integrity.

● Collaborate with web developers to resolve technical SEO and tracking issues.



Technical SEO:

● Meta Tags and On-Page Elements: Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headers, and image alt text for improved visibility and CTR.

● Comprehensive Audits: Conduct in-depth site audits using tools like Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Search Console to identify and ﬁx issues like duplicate content, thin content, canonicalization errors, and redirect chains.

● Page Speed G Core Web Vitals: Optimize page speed, including image optimization, CSS/JavaScript miniﬁcation, and improving server response times.

● Mobile Optimization: Ensure mobile-friendly pages that comply with Google’s mobile-ﬁrst indexing.

● Schema Markup Implementation: Create and implement structured data markup to enhance SERP features like rich snippets.

● Indexing G Crawling: Optimize robots.txt ﬁles, XML sitemaps, and canonical tags for efﬁcient crawling and indexing.

● Internal Linking G URL Structure: Develop and execute an internal linking strategy and improve URL structures.

● Monitoring G Troubleshooting: Continuously monitor for crawl errors and algorithmic updates using tools like Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

 

Content Creation:

● Strategic Development: Create high-quality blog posts, articles, and web pages tailored to relevant industry topics.

● SEO Optimization: Conduct keyword research and naturally integrate keywords into content using best on-page SEO practices.

● Content Auditing: Audit and update existing content for improved SEO performance.

● Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with marketing, design, and product teams to align content with broader goals.

● Performance Monitoring: Track content performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush.



Data Analysis and Reporting:

● Performance Monitoring: Use tools like Tapclicks to analyze data from platforms such as Google Search Console and GA4.

● Actionable Recommendations: Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.

● Competitor G Keyword Analysis: Conduct competitor analysis and keyword research.

● Comprehensive Reporting: Develop detailed reports capturing key metrics and ROI performance.



Collaboration and Team Integration:

● Work closely with paid media analysts and designers to create SEO-driven pages and content.

● Provide training and support on SEO best practices and tracking technologies.

● Communicate complex technical issues clearly to clients and internal teams.

● This position can be client facing, and strong communication skills is a must.

● This position will partner with the Account Strategist to be able explain and communicate the action items and plans to the client.

 

Skills Required:

● Expertise in technical SEO, including site audits, schema markup, and mobile responsiveness.

● Proﬁciency with SEO and analytics tools (SEMrush, GA4, Google Search Console, Tapclicks).

● Strong content creation skills focused on SEO optimization.

● Experience with HTML, CSS, and managing tools like Google Tag Manager.

● Analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

● Proven ability to collaborate with cross-departmental teams.

• Write engaging, natural-sounding 8–10 minute scripts.

4. Dynamic Video Editing:

• Edit fast-paced, high-retention videos (using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve).

• Include kinetic pop-up auto-captions, sound effects (SFX), subtle zooms, camera shakes, ducked background music, and smooth transitions.



5. Shorts Repurposing:

• Extract and adapt 1–2 high-performing moments from each long video into 30–45 second vertical Shorts with an engaging hook.



???? Expected Volume & Compensation:

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)
description:
We are looking for a high-performance operator who understands numbers, financial data, and business operations and can work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is ideal for someone with a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, or business analysis who wants to move beyond traditional administrative work and become a strategic partner to executive leadership.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, think analytically, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do, keep reading.



Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Coordinate with accounting, finance, tax, and operations teams

-Protect your executive's time by managing priorities and follow-through

-Drive accountability across leadership initiatives

-Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements

-Translate strategy into structured execution

-Solve problems before they become emergencies



You will work closely with executive leadership and have visibility into confidential financial and business information.



Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential.



Preferred Background



We're especially interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



-U.S. Tax Preparation or Tax Operations

-Public Accounting

-Bookkeeping

-Accounting or Finance

-Financial Analysis

-Business Analytics

-Audit or Compliance

-Controller or Accounting Support

-Executive Assistant supporting Finance or Executive Leadership



Experience with tools such as QuickBooks, Excel/Google Sheets, financial reporting software, or tax software is highly preferred.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



-Needs constant reassurance or supervision

-Struggles with direct feedback

-Prefers slow-moving corporate environments

-Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

-Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

-Is uncomfortable working with numbers, financial data, or business systems

-Frequently changes jobs every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment where ownership matters.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Within your first 90 days, you will:



-Organize and improve financial and operational reporting

-Build dashboards and executive reports that improve decision-making

-Support leadership with accurate accounting and tax-related insights

-Improve reporting processes across departments

-Run executive meetings with clear agendas and follow-up

-Anticipate leadership needs before they arise

-Track priorities and hold teams accountable

-Bring solutions, not just problems

-Operate calmly and effectively under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



-Have experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, U.S. tax, or business analysis

-Understand financial statements, reconciliations, reporting, and business metrics

-Have supported a founder, executive, or finance leader

-Have remained in at least one meaningful role for three or more years

-Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes

-Are highly organized and analytical

-Communicate clearly and professionally

-Maintain composure under pressure

-Think in terms of business outcomes, not just completing tasks



You are someone who:



-Spots financial or operational issues before others do

-Brings clarity where others see complexity

-Takes initiative without waiting to be asked

-Uses data to support better business decisions



Compensation & Growth



This role offers:



-Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

-Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making

-The opportunity to influence business operations and financial processes

-Long-term career growth as DAP Brands continues to scale



At DAP Brands, we reward impact, ownership, and results, not simply tenure.



Final Note



This opportunity is for someone who wants to grow beyond a traditional Executive Assistant role and become a trusted business partner to executive leadership.



If you have a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or financial operations and enjoy solving problems, improving systems, and helping leaders execute at a high level, we'd love to hear from you.



If you're looking for a slow-paced, highly structured corporate environment, this probably isn't the right fit.



But if you're excited to work alongside leadership, make data-driven decisions, and help build something meaningful, apply through our careers page 
 and write "MAVERICK" before your name.

title: Senior Events Coordinator
description:
DAP Brands is seeking an experienced Senior Events Coordinator to oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of our conferences, workshops, leadership retreats, and corporate events across the United States.



This role is responsible for ensuring every event is executed seamlessly,from venue selection and logistics to speaker coordination, production timelines, vendor management, and on-site operations.



While this is a remote position, the successful candidate must be willing and able to travel to the United States to support live events throughout the year.



We're looking for someone who has successfully managed business events and thrives in fast-paced environments where organization, leadership, and problem-solving are essential.



Key Responsibilities

- Event Planning & Project Management

- Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of company conferences, workshops, summits, and special events.

- Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, and event checklists.

- Build and maintain detailed Run of Show (ROS) documents.

- Ensure all project milestones and deadlines are achieved.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams throughout the planning process.



Event Logistics



Manage all event logistics, including:

- Venue selection and coordination

- Hotel room blocks and accommodations

- Airfare and ground transportation



Team travel logistics

- Speaker travel and hospitality

- Registration management

- Catering

- Audio/Visual coordination

- Event signage and branding

- Shipping and receiving

- Production schedules

- On-site staffing and volunteer coordination



Speaker & VIP Management

- Coordinate speaker communications and schedules.

- Manage presentation timelines and materials.

- Arrange travel, accommodations, and transportation.

- Ensure a professional and seamless experience for speakers, sponsors, and VIP guests.



Vendor & Venue Management

- Source and manage relationships with venues and vendors.

- Negotiate pricing and coordinate contracts.

- Oversee production companies, AV teams, photographers, videographers, decorators, printers, and other event partners.

- Ensure all vendors deliver according to schedule and expectations.



Event Operations

- Lead on-site event execution.

- Manage the Run of Show and event schedule.

- Coordinate staff assignments and responsibilities.

- Resolve operational issues in real time.

- Maintain a high-quality attendee experience from setup through teardown.



Budget & Reporting

- Track event budgets and expenses.

- Review vendor invoices.

- Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.

- Conduct post-event reviews and recommend operational improvements.



Process Improvement

- Develop and maintain event SOPs.

- Standardize planning documents and workflows.

- Improve communication and coordination across departments.

- Build scalable systems that support the company's continued growth.



Qualifications

- Required: 5+ years of experience managing corporate conferences, business events, workshops, or multi-day events.

- Demonstrated success planning and executing both virtual and in-person events.

- Experience coordinating events with 200+ attendees.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Experience developing detailed Run of Show (ROS) documents.

- Experience coordinating executive speakers, sponsors, vendors, and venues.

- Strong leadership and communication skills.

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Proficiency with project management platforms (ClickUp, Asana, 
, Trello, or similar).

- Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting educational, coaching, consulting, or professional services events.

- Experience managing trade shows, association conferences, or executive retreats.

- Familiarity with CRM and event registration platforms.

- Experience leading remote teams or coordinating distributed event staff.



Success in This Role

- A successful Events Operations Manager will:

- Deliver exceptional event experiences with minimal operational issues.

- Ensure projects remain on schedule and within budget.

- Create scalable systems and processes that improve event execution.

- Build strong relationships with vendors, speakers, and internal stakeholders.

- Lead on-site event operations with confidence and professionalism.

- Continuously improve the efficiency and quality of the Events department.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who has been responsible for making large business events successful. You understand that exceptional events are built through meticulous planning, proactive communication, and flawless execution.



If you've coordinated conferences, managed production schedules, handled last-minute travel changes, led vendor teams, and thrived under the pressure of live events, you'll be a strong fit for this role.

title: Experienced Media Buyer
description:
About the Role



DAP Brands is looking for an experienced, results-driven Media Buyer who thrives in a high-performance environment. This role is more than launching ads; you'll own campaign performance, optimize advertising spend, and identify opportunities that generate measurable ROI across the competitive U.S. market.



You'll work closely with our Marketing and Revenue teams to drive registrations and revenue for webinars, workshops, and live events through strategic paid media campaigns.



If you're competitive, analytical, enjoy testing new strategies, and love scaling winning campaigns, we'd love to meet you.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute paid media strategies that achieve lead generation, registration, and revenue goals.

- Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

- Continuously monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets based on key performance metrics including CPL, CPA, ROAS, and ROI.

- Research audiences, competitors, and market trends to uncover new advertising opportunities.

- Conduct A/B testing on creatives, messaging, targeting, and landing page performance.

- Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Analytics, and Revenue teams to build integrated campaign strategies.

- Negotiate media placements and vendor partnerships when applicable.

- Prepare performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

- Stay current on platform updates, emerging advertising trends, and best practices.



Qualifications

- Minimum of 2 years of proven experience as a Media Buyer, Media Planner, or Performance Marketer, preferably targeting the U.S. market.

- Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms, campaign optimization, and media planning.

- Experience managing paid campaigns with measurable ROI.

- Proficiency with advertising platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or similar tools.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and make data-driven decisions.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.

- Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

- Experience promoting webinars, live events, coaching programs, or high-ticket offers is a strong advantage.



Why Join DAP Brands?



At DAP Brands, we believe in rewarding performance, encouraging innovation, and empowering tea

| US Hours | WFH | $7–10 USD/hour, Depending on Experience |





We support a business owner who runs a real estate firm and a restaurant group. We're hiring a proven Executive Assistant who can run the owner's calendar, inbox, travel, and day-to-day priorities across both businesses so nothing falls through the cracks.



This is not an entry-level virtual assistant role. We need someone who has actually supported an owner or executive before, ideally in real estate, hospitality, or another fast-moving environment. If this would be your first Executive Assistant role, please do not apply.



This is a full-time role aligned to US Eastern business hours, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET.





What You'll Do



Manage the owner's calendar across both businesses: scheduling, prioritizing, resolving conflicts, confirming meetings.

Manage the owner's inbox: triaging, drafting responses, flagging what needs direct attention, following up so nothing sits.

Coordinate travel: flights, hotels, full itineraries.

Prepare for meetings: agendas, notes, and tracking follow-up items to completion.

Coordinate lightly between real estate matters (deals, leases, property issues) and restaurant operations (openings, vendor issues, staffing needs).

Communicate with vendors and contractors as directed by the owner.

Keep contracts, leases, invoices, and files organized and easy to find.

Handle ad hoc research and admin projects as they come up. Priorities shift daily between the two businesses.





Who You Are



Proven Executive Assistant experience. Non-negotiable. You have supported an owner, executive, or senior leader before. No first-time EAs.

Excellent written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You'll speak directly with vendors, tenants, and business contacts.

Real estate, hospitality, or restaurant exposure. Strongly preferred, especially in a fast-paced, owner-operated environment.

Rock-solid organization. You build your own systems and checklists by instinct. Nothing slips.

Discretion. You'll handle sensitive business and personal information and know what stays confidential.

Comfortable switching contexts fast. You can move between a real estate matter and a restaurant issue in the same hour without dropping either.

Tech-comfortable. Google Workspace and at least one task/project tool (Asana, Trello, Notion, or similar).





Schedule





Full-time, aligned to US Eastern business hours.

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.

You must be able to work this schedule consistently.





Compensation



$7 to $12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

Budget allows for the top of this range for the right candidate. Do not undersell yourself.

Independent contractor engagement, paid on a regular recurring schedule.

Room to grow: as the owner's businesses scale, there's real room for more responsibility and pay for the right person. No formal ladder, but this is a long-term seat, not a short gig.





Tech You Must Already Have



Reliable computer and reliable high-speed internet (state your speed when you apply).

Noise-cancelling headset for calls.

Working webcam for video calls.

A quiet, dedicated home workspace.





How To Apply — Follow This Exactly. Applications That Skip a Step Are Ignored.



1) Subject line: the word "Indispensable" followed by your full name.

Example: Indispensable – Juan Dela Cruz

2) Record a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself. Any tool is fine — Loom, Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), whatever you have. Keep it natural, talk to us like a real person. Do NOT read from a script. In the video, answer this: what is the most complex calendar, travel, or scheduling problem you've solved for an owner or executive, and how did you handle it? Paste a working link in your application (make sure sharing/viewing is turned on).

3) State your internet speed and confirm you can consistently work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.

We read every application that follows all three steps.

title: Senior Customer Service Operations Manager — E-commerce
description:
We sell golf balls to the US, UK, Australia, Canada, Japan and Europe.



The numbers:

1,608 tickets in the backlog today.

1,451 tickets came in last week needing a human, about 207 a day.

3 reps closing about 50 a day each, so 150 a day against 207 arriving.

The backlog grows every week.

About 60% of tickets we mark resolved get reopened.



Target: 80 tickets closed per rep per day as a floor, 100 as the goal.



Your job: make the team hit their numbers and follow the SOPs. You coach the ones who can meet the bar and replace the ones who cannot.



You inherit 3 remote reps, all in the Philippines. An AI answers most routine tickets. Every case type has a written SOP.



Two buckets of work. Shipping: where is my package, returns, exchanges, lost parcels, escalations with our fulfillment partner. Billing: cancel my subscription, refunds, charge explanations.



You will own:

- Daily ticket numbers per rep, reply quality against the SOPs, coaching, and the hard calls

- Escalations with our shipping partners, chased until closed

- Backlog and response time reporting, pulled into one daily picture with your read on it

- Creating and updating SOPs

-
, Instagram and YouTube comments and messages, which we do not cover today



You:

- At least one year in a customer service or support management role, on your CV with employer and dates

- Have cleared a backlog before and can tell us the numbers: what it was, what it became, over how long, how many people

- Excellent written English. Freshdesk and Slack.



Send three things:

1. Your CV, showing the management role and dates

2. One number you personally moved for a team: from what, to what, over how long, where

3. When does our backlog hit zero and what daily per-rep number does that take? Show the arithmetic.



Pay: $1,200 USD/month, full-time, long-term, US-daytime overlap. Paid on time, every month.
