title: Lead List Building & Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We run cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a technical, detail-oriented operator to learn and own our list-building operation.



We are specifically looking for someone with real hands-on experience in coding, software development, automation, APIs, or AI-assisted development. Technical experience is required for this position—not merely preferred. Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required because we will train you on our process.



A junior full-stack developer, automation builder, or strong technical problem-solver who is comfortable owning operational work could be a great fit.



IMPORTANT ROLE FIT



The main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating our existing list-building process. This is a technical operations position, not a developer-only position.



Coding and automation are important parts of the job, but you will not spend the entire day developing software. You will first learn the existing workflow, perform it manually, and take responsibility for delivering accurate completed lists. Once you understand the operation, you will also use Codex and other tools to fix bugs, improve our internal software, and automate useful parts of the workflow.



Manual list building and quality control will remain permanent parts of the position even as the tools improve. If you only want to develop software, build systems, or automate processes and do not want regular manual operational work, this role is not a fit.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL BACKGROUND



- You have personally built, changed, debugged, or automated real software or workflows.

- You are comfortable troubleshooting technical problems and working with code, GitHub, data, APIs, or automations.

- You can clearly explain what you personally contributed to a project and how you tested that it worked.

- Experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools to work on real software is valuable.

- Simply using ChatGPT or another AI chat tool without building, changing, or fixing real systems is not enough.



You do not need a senior developer title or a formal computer-science degree, but you do need real practical technical ability.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Learn our list-building process and the targeting rules for each client.

- Monitor campaign inventory and replenish lead lists before campaigns run low.

- Turn each client's target audience into accurate, creative search strategies.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lists using AI Ark, our internal List Builder, and approved supporting tools.

- Check company fit, decision-maker fit, recent client history, required fields, and duplicate risk.

- Export, combine, review, and deliver completed lists accurately.

- Run the required 90-day checking and personalization steps.

- Review feedback, document completed work, maintain trackers, and communicate real blockers early.

- After learning the workflow, use Codex or similar AI coding tools to diagnose bugs, fix problems, and improve your assigned copy or branch of the List Builder.

- Build useful automations and workflow improvements when they support the operation.

- Test software changes carefully. Do not change the shared production version without approval.

- After training, communicate professionally in relevant client Slack channels.



TOOLS



AI Ark, our internal List Builder,
Bison, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive, spreadsheets, CSV files, and other approved tools.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS



- Willingness to learn and permanently own the manual list-building and quality-control work, not only the coding and automation work.

- Strong technical problem-solving and critical thinking.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Reliable availability Monday-Friday from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time.

- This is a full-time role. Disclose any current jobs, clients, businesses, school, or ongoing projects before hiring. They must not interfere with the required schedule or work completed for FlowLead.

- Excellent attention to detail with filters, spreadsheets, CSV files, research, and duplicate checks.

- Honest about errors and never fabricates data.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and power/internet backup.



Previous lead-generation or list-building experience is not required. We will train you on our process.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short, specific written application. Briefly:



- Describe one real coding, automation, or AI-assisted development project that you personally built, changed, or fixed. Include the tools you used and what you personally did.

- Confirm that you understand the main day-to-day responsibility is manually operating the list-building process and that this will remain part of the job.

- Confirm that you can work full-time from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time, and disclose any other current jobs or regular commitments.



Honest, specific answers are more useful than generic AI-written responses.



HIRING PROCESS



Written application review, short interview, and a 30-45 minute Apollo search-strategy assignment for selected candidates. The assignment tests how well you learn a manual search process, use judgment, and pay attention to detail—not your previous list-building experience. Candidates do not receive client data or production access during hiring.

We've helped hundreds of founders and entrepreneurs build their own personal brands. Our clients have a combined following of more than 3.5 million people, and the content we've worked on has generated over 600 million views.



That's the level of work you'd be stepping into. The videos you edit get seen.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



You'll be editing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok and similar platforms, plus long-form content for YouTube. Some of it for our own brand, some of it for the founders and entrepreneurs we work with.



Day to day that means:



- Editing Reels and shorts that need to hold attention from the first frame

- Cutting long-form YouTube videos that keep people watching all the way through

- Working directly with our team on what a video needs before it goes out

- Turning around a consistent volume of work every week without the quality dropping





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



Knowing the software is the starting point, not the job. We want an editor who understands the psychology behind a video that performs: where the hook lands, where attention drops, when a cut adds energy and when it just adds noise, when b-roll helps and when it's a distraction.



If you watch a video that did well and you can explain why it did well, you're the kind of person we want to talk to.

- At least a few years of professional editing experience

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects. If DaVinci Resolve is your main tool, that works too

- Real experience with social media content, especially short-form

- A good eye for pacing, sound design, captions and everything that makes a video feel alive

- Reliability. We work with clients who have real deadlines





MORE DETAILS:



This is a full-time position. You'd become part of our team, not a freelancer we send files to every now and then.

title: Video Editor, Client SOP Videos
description:
The Role

You'll turn our clients' raw workflow recordings and interviews into clean, clear SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) videos, quickly and accurately, so their teams can train, transition, and document with confidence and so a key step in our client delivery serves as a competitive advantage and client experience enhancement, not a bottleneck.



Why This Matters

These videos are one part of a larger SOP package we deliver to clients. The editing isn't about flashy effects nor is it something that a typical AI workflow software solves. It's about human judgment and clear thinking: watching the content, understanding it, and shaping it so it's concise, complete, and easy to learn from. 

This also makes communication and responsiveness as important as the editing itself. We're looking for someone who seeks to understand the material, asks good questions, gives and takes feedback, and stays in close contact with the team as work moves.

When we do this well, our clients get "the wonderful SOPs you built," creating opportunities for them to hire and scale, and our internal process runs better and adds marketability to our firm. You'll be a real contributor to that result.



What You'll Do

• Edit raw SOP, screen-recording and interview-style videos. Remove gaps and dead time, tighten for conciseness without losing meaning, and clean up loading delays or "spinning wheel" moments.

• Find the natural breakpoints. Listen to the content and cut it into coherent, standalone segments that make sense for training and consumption, almost like course modules.

• Protect confidentiality. Watch for sensitive or client information in the background and handle it according to our standards.

• Keep files and workflow organized to company conventions, so what we need is easy to find and hand off.

• Deliver a rough cut before final clips. One continuous file, dead time and filler out, layout set, breakpoints thoughtfully marked. We confirm or adjust, then you cut to that.

• Stay responsive and communicate as work moves. Post updates, questions, and decisions in provided tools, and flag delays or difficulties early so nothing stalls silently. 

• Join a short weekly check-in and contribute to planning and team discussions. Raise concerns about timing or quality and suggest improvements both upstream (e.g. how we create better raw video) and downstream (e.g. ensuring the usefulness and coherence of all SOP deliverables).

• Over time, and depending on fit and capacity, help with first-pass SOP drafts from transcripts using AI tools, and occasionally other short-form or long-form content.



Who We're Looking For

• A strong communicator who understands the material and the requirements, asks questions rather than guessing, and gives and receives feedback well.

• A team participant who stays responsive, keeps the team updated, and works as part of the process rather than going quiet and delivering in isolation.

• Solid technical video editing skill, with a portfolio you can share.

• The judgment to edit for meaning: finding breakpoints and shaping content for comprehension, not only trimming clips.

• Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to work through technical material from different sources and different communication styles.

• Integrity and care with sensitive or confidential information.

• Organized and reliable with files, workflow, and turnaround.

• A collaborator who improves a process from within and cares about the end result for the client.



Nice To Have

• Experience with training, course, or SOP-style content.

• Comfort using AI and transcript tools in a content workflow.

• Short-form or long-form video editing.

• Familiarity with US business context, or the appetite to learn it.



Logistics

• Remote and mostly async. The only fixed overlap is one weekly team meeting in the morning, US Central Time. You manage your own schedule around reliable, predictable turnaround and staying reachable during the work week.

• Capacity & Structure: Retainer, not project-by-project. Guaranteed minimum units per month, overflow rate above that.  One unit is up to 60 minutes of source footage, in 60-minute increments. Measured on the raw file we send, confirmed at handoff, never at invoice.

• Volume: Roughly 10-12 units per month, plus a standing backlog. There's always work available.

• Delivery & Turnaround. Rough cut within 48 hours (2 business days) of the cut sheet and raw file. One continuous file, dead time and filler out, layout set, breakpoints marked. We confirm or adjust, then you cut to that. Final clips within 48 hours (2 business days) of our feedback. Both clocks start when we hand off, so our delays are never on you.

• Confidentiality. Live client business data. NDA before any footage moves. Work stays in the accounts we provide, nothing on personal drives. 

• Dedicated setup required: your own computer and stable internet plus the ability to keep our clients' confidential material protected.

• Start date: aiming for on or before August 31, ready to edit from day one.

• Compensation. $500-$1,000 monthly retainer for 12 guaranteed units, plus overflow. Include your rate or a rate range in your application.



Where This Can Lead

This seat sits within our client fulfillment process. The right person grows from part-time to full-time video editor and ultimately into a process contributor, shaping how we build SOPs and, over time, helping us do more content and AV work related to our own processes and thought leadership.



How To Apply

Send a short note (not a template) and tell me why this role interests you.  Also include a link to your portfolio. So I know you read this, start your message with the word "SOP." Strong candidates will be asked to complete a short, paid editing test before any hire.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

? - Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

? - Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

? - A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

? - The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

? - The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

? - Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

? - Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

? - Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

? - An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

? - Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

? - Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

? - Remote, international team

? - Contractor position, paid biweekly

? - Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

? - Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.

? 

Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor

? 

You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.

? 

Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.

? 

Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Male E-commerce Operations Specialist – Long-Term Remote Role
description:
We are looking for a full-time E-commerce Operations Specialist to take responsibility for a broad set of recurring and occasional operational processes.



Please note: This is a reposted version of a role we recently advertised. If you already applied to the previous version of this position, please do not submit another application. We already have your previous application on file.



Working arrangement:

• Full-time, long-term remote role

• 40 working hours per week

• At least 5 regular working hours overlapping with 10:00–18:00 Sofia, Bulgaria time

• The work cannot be performed at the same time as another job or client engagement

• You need a reliable, quiet and sufficiently private workspace suitable for occasional calls

• Clear written English is required; perfect English is not



You may be a strong fit for this role if you are the kind of person who wants to understand how a process works – not only complete its steps. You notice when information is missing, question results that do not make sense, follow up without repeated reminders, and look for practical ways to make recurring work more reliable.



Direct experience with every platform or responsibility listed below is not required. We care more about reliability, attention to detail, sound judgment, clear communication and the ability to learn. Relevant e-commerce or operations experience is useful, but it is not a substitute for these qualities.



We are a small but growing e-commerce team operating several brands and selling across multiple international markets. Because the team is small, good work is visible and the right person can gradually take on more ownership, improve how the company operates and grow their compensation as their responsibilities expand.



Several members of our team are based in the Philippines and have worked with us full-time for an extended period. They have told us that this is the best company they have worked for, which we believe reflects the respectful, supportive and stable working environment we try to create.



Your work will include a mix of recurring process-based tasks and occasional situations that require investigation and judgment. You will receive training and access to detailed operating procedures. We do not expect you to know all our systems immediately, but we do expect you to understand the processes as you learn them, ask focused questions and gradually require less supervision.



When useful for the role, we are open to providing relevant training and educational resources.



The work will include several main areas:



Orders, suppliers and shipments

• Keep order and shipment tracking spreadsheets updated

• Follow production, inspection, dispatch, transit and delivery status

• Identify delays, missing information and discrepancies



Inventory and operational monitoring

• Keep inventory and operational tracking spreadsheets updated

• Notice missing information, unusual changes or potential stock issues and raise them when appropriate

• Follow existing inventory and replenishment processes accurately



Quality control and detailed checking

• Organize product inspections

• Review inspection photos, videos and reports



Customer support and coordination

• Help handle customer support cases when needed - text support only, not voice

• Provide backup coverage during busy periods or when another team member is unavailable



You are likely to succeed here if you:



• Are reliable and consistent without needing repeated reminders

• Pay close attention to details, especially when similar products, quantities, dates and markets are involved

• Are comfortable with recurring operational work and following processes consistently

• Want to understand why a process exists

• Notice missing information, contradictions and risks

• Use judgment when instructions do not perfectly fit the situation

• Communicate clearly and raise problems early

• Follow tasks through until they are genuinely complete

• Suggest practical improvements when you notice a better way of doing something



Previous experience in e-commerce, Amazon, Shopify, spreadsheets, logistics, supplier coordination, shipment tracking, customer operations, quality control or automation will be useful.

However, experience in any of these areas is not strictly required. We are primarily selecting for the qualities above and your ability to learn.



Compensation will depend on relevant experience and demonstrated capability. There is room for increases as you become more independent, perform reliably and take ownership of additional responsibilities.



The first step is a short application questionnaire.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to recorded interview questions, job-relevant assessments or practical tasks, followed by live conversations for selected candidates. The rules regarding AI and other tools will be stated clearly for each stage.



Important:

Please complete the application form without generative AI assistance.

Do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or another generative AI system to draft, translate, rewrite or improve any free-text response.



Basic spelling correction is permitted, and you may look up the meaning of an unfamiliar word. Perfect English is not required; clear, specific and honest answers are more valuable than polished corporate language.



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph and complete the application form here:

https://tally.so/r/GxEXM2



We review candidates through the form so that everyone is evaluated consistently. No cover letter is required; the questionnaire replaces it.



Thank you for taking the time to apply carefully. We will review complete applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next step.

title: Direct Response Copywriter | Facebook / Meta Ads
description:

This is a collaborative system. You will work closely with management, receive structured feedback on every batch, and revise scripts based on both team notes and real ad performance. description:

About the Role:

Audio: Clean audio, balanced sound levels, and optional subtle background music if needed.

title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
description:
# Social Media & Content Coordinator



**Location:**  online

**Employment Type:** Full-time – depending on the right candidate

**Reports to:** Founder

**Brands:** Food Voyageur + our growing portfolio of businesses



## About the Role



We are looking for a creative, highly organised and social-media-obsessed **Social Media & Content Coordinator** to take ownership of the day-to-day content across our portfolio of four growing businesses.



Currently, our Founder manages much of the social media personally. As our businesses continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can step in and **own the content calendar, creation, editing, scheduling, posting and community engagement across our brands.**



This is not a role where you'll be waiting for someone to tell you what to post each day.



We want someone who can look ahead, identify upcoming occasions and opportunities, plan content around them, repurpose the huge amount of content we already have, and keep our brands consistently active and growing.



You will have access to existing photos and videos as well as new footage captured by our team. Your job is to turn that content into engaging Reels, TikToks, Stories and posts.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Content Creation & Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and other social platforms

* Turn raw footage into engaging, fast-paced social content

* Repurpose existing videos and high-performing content into fresh posts

* Create graphics and social content using **Canva**

* Edit and enhance images using **Adobe Lightroom**

* Add captions, hooks, trending audio, text overlays and calls-to-action

* Create different versions of content suitable for each platform

* Write engaging captions, hooks and social copy

* Develop scripts and concepts for videos for the Founder and team to film



### Social Media Management



* Manage day-to-day social media activity across **four businesses**

* Publish content consistently across Instagram,
 and TikTok

* Upload Instagram Stories daily

* Schedule posts in advance

* Ensure every brand remains active and consistent

* Monitor comments, DMs and audience engagement

* Proactively engage with relevant accounts and communities

* Identify trends and opportunities our brands can participate in



### Content Calendar & Planning



* Own and maintain the social media content calendar

* Plan content weeks in advance rather than working day-to-day

* Identify upcoming occasions, events and seasonal opportunities

* Examples include Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Easter, Christmas, weddings, graduations and other relevant events

* Coordinate campaigns around product launches, promotions and business milestones

* Ensure content is prepared and scheduled ahead of important dates

* Work with the Founder to turn business priorities into social campaigns



### Influencer & Creator Management



* Research influencers and content creators relevant to each brand

* Proactively reach out to potential influencers and collaborators

* Coordinate gifting and collaboration opportunities

* Maintain an influencer/contact database

* Follow up with creators and ensure agreed content is delivered

* Identify opportunities for UGC and creator partnerships



### Growth & Engagement



This role isn't just about posting content — **we want someone who wants to grow our brands.**



You will:



* Monitor social media performance and identify what is working

* Track follower growth, reach, engagement and content performance

* Test different hooks, formats, posting times and content styles

* Identify high-performing content that can be repurposed

* Look for opportunities to increase organic reach

* Help grow our Instagram and TikTok profiles

* Bring new ideas to the table rather than simply executing instructions



## What We're Looking For



You don't necessarily need years of agency experience.



We're more interested in someone who **understands social media, has a great creative eye and can show us what they can create.**



You should have:



* Strong video editing skills

* Strong knowledge of Instagram Reels and TikTok

* Canva experience

* Adobe Lightroom experience

* Excellent written communication and caption-writing skills

* Understanding of hooks, storytelling and short-form content

* Strong organisational and content-planning skills

* Ability to manage multiple brands simultaneously

* Understanding of social media trends

* Confidence reaching out to influencers and creators

* Ability to work independently and take ownership

* A proactive mindset — you see an opportunity and act on it



Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar video editing software** is highly regarded.



## The Person We're Looking For



You'll probably love this role if you're the person who:



Sees a trend on TikTok and immediately thinks, *"We could do this for the brand."*



Has 30 videos sitting in a folder and sees **50 pieces of content**, not a pile of files.



Notices Mother's Day is approaching and has the campaign planned weeks before anyone needs to ask.



Can take a 60-second piece of raw footage and turn it into a Reel people actually want to watch.



And most importantly, you're comfortable **taking ownership**.



## What Success Looks Like



Within this role, we want to see:



* Consistent daily social media activity across our brands

* A content calendar planned ahead of time

* Stronger and more consistent brand presentation

* Increasing engagement and organic reach

* Growth across Instagram and TikTok

* Regular influencer and creator collaborations

* Existing content being effectively repurposed

* Less reliance on the Founder for day-to-day social media management



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your CV

2. Examples of social media accounts or content you've worked on

3. **3–5 Reels/TikToks you have personally edited or created**

4. A short explanation of why you think you'd be a great fit for this role



**Bonus:** Send us an example of a brand you think is doing social media exceptionally well and tell us why.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry to learn and excited about helping build and grow multiple brands.



If you love creating content and understand that great social media is about **attention, storytelling, consistency and community — we'd love to hear from you.**

Rebuild competitor funnels in Funnelish — page by page, matching the flow, layout and offer structure of the original

Swap in our own assets — our product images, our branding, our creatives. We don't ship someone else's images.

Improve the copy — rewrite headlines, hooks, bullets and CTAs in your own words where the original is weak. Never copy-paste the competitor's text.

Set up the checkout — order bumps, post-purchase 1-click upsells and downsells, payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), correct currency, language and pricing per EU market

Build geo-funnels — the same offer adapted per country, with the right currency and local pricing

Wire up tracking — Meta Pixel / CAPI, TikTok Pixel, GA4. Every funnel goes live with tracking tested and confirmed working.

QA on mobile — most of our traffic is mobile and paid. Slow, broken or ugly-on-mobile pages cost us money directly.

Deliver volume — multiple funnels per week, live and ready for traffic

What we're looking for



Must have:



Hands-on experience building e-commerce funnels — Funnelish strongly preferred; ClickFunnels, Zipify/OCU, GemPages or similar considered if you can learn Funnelish fast

Fast and accurate with a drag-and-drop builder. You can look at a page and rebuild it without asking how.

A good eye — your rebuild should look better than the original, not like a cheap knockoff

Decent English copywriting: you can rewrite a headline or a bullet list and make it stronger

Basic HTML/CSS for tweaks the builder won't do

Comfortable with pixels and tracking QA — you can tell when an event fires twice or not at all

Self-managing. You get a link, you deliver a finished funnel. No hand-holding.



Nice to have:



Experience in the health & beauty / supplements / skincare space, and awareness of what claims you can and can't put on a page in the EU

Experience with COD funnels or multi-currency / multi-language selling across EU markets

Klaviyo, upsell apps, post-purchase
/SMS

Experience working with media buyers on scaling campaigns

Why this role

Clear, repeatable work — you always know exactly what "done" looks like

Long-term, full-time position. Steady hours, steady pay, every week.

Direct impact: your funnels are the ones we put ad spend behind

No meetings culture, no approval chains

How to apply



We only review applications that show us actual work. No portfolio = no reply.



Send links to 2–3 live funnels or landing pages you built yourself. Working URLs, not screenshots, not a PDF. Say what you personally built on each one.

Show a rebuild if you have one: a page or funnel you recreated or modeled on another one. Send both links — the original and yours.

Tell us your speed: how long does one full funnel rebuild take you, and what's your setup for working that fast?

Your Funnelish experience in one line: how long, how many funnels, at what monthly ad spend.

Start the first line of your application with the word "UPSELL" so we know you read the whole post.



We reply to every serious application within a few days. Shortlisted candidates get one paid test funnel before we make an offer.

title: Exciting Content Creator
description:
# Senior Content Creator — Video, Graphics & Social Media



## Create Content That People Actually Stop and Watch



We are looking for a talented, ambitious and highly creative **Senior Content Creator** to work full-time across our growing portfolio of Australian brands.



This is not a basic Canva-posting role.



We need someone who understands attention, storytelling and brand positioning—and can turn ideas, voice notes and raw footage into polished content that looks premium and performs online.



You will create short-form videos, social graphics, advertisements and branded content for businesses across healthcare, property and professional services.



## What You’ll Create



- Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

- 
 and
 content

- Promotional and brand videos

- Property and healthcare advertisements

- Social-media graphics and carousels

- Animated graphics and motion content

- Video captions, hooks and thumbnails

- Campaign concepts and content series

- Founder-led personal-brand content

- Internal and recruitment content when required



## Your Responsibilities



- Work directly with the Director to develop content ideas

- Turn voice notes, briefs and raw footage into engaging content

- Edit professional short-form and long-form videos

- Design premium graphics that are consistent with each brand

- Write strong hooks, captions and calls to action

- Repurpose one piece of content across multiple platforms

- Maintain a structured content calendar

- Organise and manage all content files and brand assets

- Research trends without blindly copying them

- Recommend new creative concepts and campaign ideas

- Deliver content consistently and meet agreed deadlines

- Review performance and improve future content

- Maintain a high standard across every brand



## About You



You are:



- An experienced content creator with a strong portfolio

- Highly skilled in video editing and graphic design

- Able to create content that feels modern, premium and engaging

- Confident creating both corporate and personality-driven content

- Strong at storytelling, pacing, hooks and visual composition

- Able to understand different audiences and brand voices

- Proactive—you bring ideas instead of waiting for instructions

- Fast without sacrificing quality

- Organised and able to manage multiple brands

- Receptive to feedback and comfortable making revisions

- An excellent written and spoken English communicator

- Reliable, accountable and interested in a long-term position



## Preferred Skills



Experience with several of the following is highly desirable:



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- After Effects

- Photoshop

- Illustrator

- CapCut

- Canva

- AI-assisted creative tools

- Motion graphics

- Colour grading

- Audio editing

- Social-media content strategy

- Direct-response advertising

- Personal-brand content

- Property or healthcare marketing



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first three months:



- Each brand has a consistent and professional visual identity

- Content is planned and produced ahead of schedule

- Raw ideas are converted into polished content with minimal supervision

- Videos have strong hooks, clean editing and clear messaging

- Social accounts publish consistently

- The Director spends less time managing content production

- Engagement, reach and content quality show measurable improvement



## Why Join Us?



- Full-time, long-term remote role

- Work directly with the Director

- Create content across several exciting Australian brands

- Take ownership of creative direction and content production

- Build a diverse, high-quality portfolio

- Opportunity to grow into a Creative Lead position

- Your ideas will be heard and implemented

- Significant responsibility for the right person



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé

2. A link to your portfolio

3. Three examples of short-form videos you personally edited

4. Three examples of graphics or carousels you personally designed

5. An example of content that achieved a strong result

6. A short explanation of your creative process

7. The software and tools you use

8. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

9. Your availability and earliest starting date



Please also record a brief video introduction telling us:



- Who you are

- What makes your content different

- Which brands or creators inspire your work

- Why you would be a great fit for this position



Begin your application with the words **“I CREATE ATTENTION”** so we know you have read the entire advertisement.



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Costumer support expert
description:
Customer Support & Hospitality Expert



Join a fast-growing European e-commerce business



We are not looking for someone who simply answers customer
s.



We are looking for someone who understands that great customer support is hospitality.



Someone who can turn a frustrated customer into a loyal one.

Someone who notices problems before we point them out.

Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

And someone who genuinely enjoys making customers feel heard, respected and taken care of.



We are building and scaling a fast-growing e-commerce business, and customer experience is extremely important to us.



Our standards are high.



We want our support to become better as we grow, not more impersonal.



That is why we are looking for a Customer Support & Hospitality Expert who can eventually take ownership of a large part of our daily customer service and help us raise the standard even further.



This role is for you if...



You are naturally proactive.



You don't just answer the question in front of you. You think one step ahead:



What does this customer actually need?

How can I solve this properly?

How can we prevent this problem next time?



You understand that the tone of a message matters just as much as the solution.



You can stay warm and professional when a customer is impatient, disappointed or angry.



You don't hide behind policies.



You look for solutions while protecting the interests of the business.



And perhaps most importantly: you take responsibility.



If you see something that can be improved, we expect you to tell us.



What you will be responsible for



* Managing daily customer support

* Answering customer
s professionally and naturally

* Helping customers with orders, delivery, tracking, returns and product questions

* Handling complaints calmly and solution-oriented

* Following up instead of letting issues disappear in an inbox

* Recognising recurring customer problems

* Proactively suggesting improvements to our processes, FAQ, communication and customer journey

* Keeping communication organised and making sure nothing is forgotten

* Protecting the reputation and trust of our brands with every interaction



As you grow into the role, we want you to increasingly own customer support rather than simply execute tasks.



What we care about most



Experience is valuable.



But experience alone will not get you this job.



We care much more about:



Ownership — you feel responsible for the outcome.



Proactivity — you don't need us to notice everything first.



Hospitality — you know how to make people feel genuinely taken care of.



Communication — your writing is clear, warm, calm and professional.



Problem-solving — you look for solutions instead of immediately escalating everything.



Attention to detail — order numbers, tracking information, promises and follow-ups need to be correct.



Hunger to improve — you actively want to become exceptionally good at what you do.



We would rather hire someone extremely driven and coachable than someone with five years of experience who operates on autopilot.



Show us that you are good



Please don't send us a generic application.



We want to understand how you think.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Tell us briefly about your previous customer support or e-commerce experience.



2. Give us one real example where you personally improved the customer experience.

   What was the situation? What did you do differently? What was the result?



3. What is something you changed or suggested in a previous role that made the customer support operation better?



4. In your opinion, what is the difference between average customer support and exceptional customer hospitality?



5. Imagine a customer has been waiting longer than expected for their order and is getting frustrated. They write:



"Where is my order? I have been waiting for days and nobody is giving me a clear answer. This is unacceptable."



Write the exact reply you would send to this customer.



6. Tell us one thing you would want to analyse or improve during your first month with us.



We pay close attention to these answers.



There are no trick questions. We simply want to see whether you have the level of judgement, empathy and initiative we are looking for.



Generic or copy-paste applications will not move forward.



Compensation & first month



$3–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



The first month will be a paid traineeship.



During this month, you will learn how we work, our standards and our way of communicating with customers.



At the same time, we will look at how quickly you learn, how independently you work, how you communicate and — especially — whether you proactively make things better.



If there is a strong match, our goal is to build a long-term collaboration and give you increasing responsibility as the business grows.



The person we hope to find



You might already be an experienced e-commerce customer support specialist.



Or perhaps you have worked in hospitality and have an unusually strong instinct for taking care of people.



Either way, we are looking for someone who eventually makes us think:



“We don't need to worry about customer support anymore — this person owns it.”



If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.



But don't just tell us that you are hardworking, proactive or customer-focused.



Show us through your answers.



This job position will start from the end of september!

mber

Required Skills

, TikTok, LinkedIn, or YouTube

* The ability to communicate proactively and ask questions when instructions are unclear

* Reliable internet access and a dependable computer

* The ability to receive feedback and make revisions quickly

* A portfolio showing previous video editing, graphic design, or social media work



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Financial services

* Personal branding

* Digital marketing agencies

* Sales funnels

* Lead generation

* GoHighLevel

* 

* Asana

What Success Looks Like



The person selected for this role will help us:



* Publish content consistently across all major platforms

* Turn raw recordings into polished, engaging content

* Increase engagement and qualified conversations

* Build a more organized and reliable content production system

* Respond to comments and messages promptly

* Improve content performance over time using analytics

* Reduce the amount of day-to-day content management required from the owner



You will be evaluated based on consistency, communication, quality of work, ability to meet deadlines, content output, engagement, and qualified leads generated through social media.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership of their work

* Does not need to be reminded repeatedly about deadlines

* Communicates when there is a problem instead of disappearing

* Pays close attention to instructions

* Can work independently

* Is creative but also organized

* Can follow an established brand style

* Is comfortable suggesting new ideas

* Wants a stable, long-term position

You will work closely with company management and become a key member of our team, responsible for continuously improving how our brand is presented across our website, social media, advertising,
 marketing and all digital channels.



We want someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions.



You should be able to identify opportunities, bring ideas to us, develop campaigns, create outstanding content and take ownership of projects from concept through to execution.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to:



AI Image & Content Creation

, TikTok, YouTube and digital advertising.

Instagram


TikTok

LinkedIn

YouTube and other relevant channels

Responsibilities will include:



Creating and updating products.

Improving product pages and collections.

Updating homepage content and promotional banners.

Creating landing pages.

Managing images, videos and website content.

Improving navigation and customer experience.

Identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Monitoring the website and proactively recommending improvements.

EDM &
 Marketing



Take responsibility for our
 marketing strategy, including:



Designing professional EDM campaigns.

Developing promotional and brand campaigns.

Customer segmentation.

Automated
 flows.

Abandoned cart campaigns.

New customer and welcome sequences.

Customer re-engagement.

Product launches and announcements.

Analysing open rates, click-through rates and conversions.

Continuously testing and improving performance.



Experience with Klaviyo or similar leading
 marketing platforms is highly desirable.



Digital Marketing & Brand Development



You will help us develop and execute our overall digital marketing strategy.



This may include:



Campaign planning.

Content strategy.

Competitor research.

SEO and organic content.

Meta advertising creative.

Google advertising creative.

Landing page development.

Retargeting campaigns.

Conversion optimisation.

Marketing analytics.

New product launches.

Brand development.



You should understand the difference between simply creating attractive content and creating content that generates engagement, enquiries and sales.



AI Expertise Is Essential



We are specifically looking for someone who is advanced in AI and passionate about emerging technology.



You should already be using a combination of leading AI platforms for:



Image generation

Image editing

Product visualisation

Video generation

Video editing

Copywriting

Marketing

Research

Automation

Content creation



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Kling, Veo, Canva, Photoshop, CapCut and other leading AI platforms will be highly regarded.



We are not concerned if you use different platforms.



What matters is the quality of what you can produce.



Who We Are Looking For



The successful applicant should have:



Proven digital marketing experience.

Advanced AI image generation skills.

AI video generation and video editing experience.

Strong Shopify experience.

Social media management experience.

Graphic design and excellent visual judgement.

EDM/email marketing experience.

Strong written English.

Excellent attention to detail.

Understanding of e-commerce and conversion optimisation.

Strong organisational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Ability to work independently.

A commercial mindset and understanding of what drives online sales.

Genuine interest in AI and emerging digital technology.



Experience within furniture, interiors, architecture, homewares, luxury products or design-focused e-commerce would be highly regarded.



Most Importantly



We are looking for someone with an exceptional eye for design and branding.



Our products are highly visual. The successful person must understand premium presentation, interior design aesthetics, composition, typography, imagery and how to make a product and brand look aspirational.



We want someone who will look at our current marketing and think:



“I know how I can make this better.”



Then have the ability to actually execute it.



This Role Is NOT Suitable For



This position will not suit someone who has only basic Canva skills, basic social media experience or has recently started experimenting with AI.



We are looking for an experienced, high-level candidate capable of taking genuine ownership of our digital marketing and creative output.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your CV/resume.

Your portfolio.

Examples of social media accounts you have managed.

Examples of AI-generated images you personally created.

Examples of AI-generated or edited videos you personally created.

Examples of Shopify websites you have worked on.

Examples of EDM/email campaigns you have created.

A list of the AI and marketing tools you currently use.

Your current internet speed and computer specifications.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Applications without a portfolio and examples of previous work will not be considered.



IMPORTANT – Application Question

We are not looking for generic AI-generated answers.

Employment

title: E-commerce Operations Manager for Dutch Premium Health Brand | Start Hands-On, Then Build Your Own Team | Full-Time, Lon
description:
Start your application with the word AMBER so we know you read this post carefully.

 

Hi! I'm Chaya, founder of Panacea Light Therapy (
), a premium red light therapy brand in the Netherlands. We sell high-end wellness devices through our Shopify store and 
, and we are growing fast. Until now I have done almost everything myself. I am looking for one person I can really build with: my operations manager, long-term.

 

Important: this is a manager role, but you will NOT start by managing. You will start by doing all the work yourself, so you understand every process from the inside: every type of customer question, every shipping problem, every return. Once you have mastered the operation, you will recruit a customer service member to work under you, train them using our handbooks, and manage them, while you keep overseeing the whole operation. If you only want to delegate from day one, this is not your job. If you want to build and lead something, it is.

 

This is a stable, full-time, direct-hire position. No agency in between. If you do great work, you will be with us for years and your team will grow with the company.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

PHASE 1 (roughly the first months): master the operation yourself

 

• Own our customer service inbox (Gorgias:
, WhatsApp, social media). Our customers are Dutch, so you will read and write in Dutch with the help of Claude (AI). You do NOT need to speak Dutch, but you DO need to be an expert at working with AI. We have detailed handbooks, saved answers, and tone-of-voice rules for you.

 

• Handle everything around orders in Shopify: order changes, discount codes, return labels, customer records.

 

• Chase lost or delayed shipments with our fulfilment center and carriers, keep the customer calmly informed, and follow every case through to the end.

 

• Process return requests in Returnless and 
 customer questions in Seller Central.

 

• Keep a clear daily overview in Notion: open cases, shipment issues, and a short end-of-day report so nothing ever falls through the cracks.

 

• Light website maintenance in Shopify and other tasks as we grow. You will not do design or ads; we have people for that.

 

PHASE 2 (once you have proven you run the operation smoothly): build your team

 

• Recruit a customer service member yourself: write the job post, screen, interview, and propose your hire to me for final approval.

 

• Train them using the handbooks and processes you have mastered, and improve that documentation as you go.

 

• Manage their daily work and quality, handle the difficult cases yourself, and stay the owner of the full operation: customer service, shipments, returns.

 

• Report to me weekly in one clear overview: what runs well, what needs a decision, what you propose.

 

 

WHO YOU ARE

 

• You think like an owner, not a task-taker. You want to understand the whole machine, fix what is broken, and eventually lead people. Experience training or managing at least one other person is a strong plus; tell us about it.

 

• You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day and can show it. This is a hard requirement. You will work in Dutch through AI, so "pretty good with AI" is not enough; we are looking for someone exceptional at it.

 

• Solid hands-on experience running Shopify stores for brands doing $100,000+ per month in revenue, preferably in the European market. You know what daily operations look like at that level: order volume, returns, carriers, and customers who expect premium service. Tell us about these stores in your application.

 

• 2+ years experience in e-commerce customer service.

 

• Genuinely empathetic. Our devices cost up to EUR 1,500 and our customers are often dealing with health struggles. Warm, patient, premium communication matters more to us than speed.

 

• Extremely organized and stable. You keep overviews, you close loops, you never leave a case half-finished. If you tend to disappear when things get busy, this is not the job for you.

 

• Excellent written English (we work together in English; customers are handled in Dutch via AI).

 

• Available full-time (40 hrs/week) with at least 4 hours of overlap with Amsterdam business hours (CET), roughly 3 PM to 7 PM Philippine time or more.

 

• Reliable internet plus a backup plan for power/internet outages.

 

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

• $800 to $1,200 USD per month depending on experience, paid on time every month, directly to you.

 

• 13th month pay.

 

• Paid Philippine holidays and paid leave after the probation period.

 

• Yearly performance reviews with real raise potential as the company grows.

 

• Extensive documentation and training: you will never be thrown in the deep end.

 

• A calm, respectful, no-drama work culture. I care about doing things well, not about micromanaging you.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

1. Start your application with the word AMBER.

 

2. Answer these 5 questions (short and honest, no AI-written essays please; ironic, we know):

 

Question 1: Describe a concrete example of how you use Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work. What exactly do you ask it, and how do you check its output?

 

Question 2: Tell me about a time you handled an angry customer whose package was lost. What did you do, step by step?

 

Question 3: How do you keep track of open cases so nothing gets forgotten? Name the actual system or method you use.

 

Question 4: Which Shopify stores have you worked on? For each: the market (EU/US/other), the approximate monthly revenue, and what you were responsible for day to day.

 

Question 5: Have you ever trained or managed another person (VA, agent, small team)? What did you learn about it, and why do you want a role where you first do the work yourself before you lead?

 

3. Include your expected monthly salary and your earliest start date.

 

Applications that skip the word AMBER or the 5 questions will not be read. I reply personally to every serious application.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Service Businesses (EST, Full Time)
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team
