title: B2B Appointment Setter / Vending Location Acquisition – Australia
description:
Base Salary + Uncapped Commission | Work From Home – Philippines



We are a growing Australian vending and smart retail operator based in Sydney.



We are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter / outbound salesperson whose job is simple:



Find us great locations for our vending machines and smart coolers.



This is not a general VA role and it is not customer service.



You will spend your day prospecting, calling,
ing, using LinkedIn, following up and speaking with Australian business decision-makers.



What You Will Do



* Research and build targeted prospect lists

* Make outbound B2B calls every day

* Prospect through LinkedIn and

* Reach decision-makers including Operations Managers, HR, Facility Managers, Office Managers, Business Owners and Site Managers

* Qualify locations against our criteria

* Book qualified site meetings for our Australian team

* Follow up prospects consistently until you receive a clear yes or no

* Maintain every prospect and activity in our CRM



We are targeting businesses such as:



* Warehouses and distribution centres

* Manufacturing facilities

* Large offices

* Gyms and fitness centres

* Hospitals and healthcare

* Schools and education

* Automotive businesses

* High-traffic workplaces and commercial facilities



What Are You Offering?



Modern vending machines and AI-powered smart coolers that can be supplied, installed, stocked, maintained and managed by us at no cost to qualifying locations.



You are not expected to close complicated sales.



Your objective is to:



Find the right site → reach the right person → create interest → qualify the opportunity → book the meeting.



Our Australian team takes over from there.



Who We Want



You MUST have previous experience in:



* B2B cold calling

* Appointment setting

* Lead generation or business development

* Speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers



You should also be:



* Highly confident speaking English

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Persistent without being aggressive

* Strong at objection handling

* Capable of researching your own prospects

* Experienced with LinkedIn prospecting and cold

* Comfortable working with a CRM

* Motivated by targets and commission



If most of your experience is inbound customer service or general VA work, this position is probably not for you.



Compensation



Base salary: PHP 35,000–45,000/month depending on experience



PLUS:



* Commission for qualified appointments

* Significant commission for locations successfully placed

* Monthly performance bonuses

* Uncapped earning potential



Strong performers should have the ability to earn significantly more than their base salary.



Working Hours



Full-time.



You will work primarily during Sydney, Australia business hours.



How We Measure Performance



We care about outcomes, not activity for the sake of activity.



We will measure:



* New businesses prospected

* Decision-makers reached

* Qualified conversations

* Follow-ups completed

* Qualified appointments held

* Locations approved

* Machines successfully installed



How to Apply



Do NOT send us a generic application.



Please send:



1. Your CV.

2. A 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself.

3. A short voice recording as though you were calling an Australian Operations Manager to discuss placing a vending machine at their workplace.

4. Answers to the following questions:



**A.** How many outbound B2B calls did you typically make each day in your previous role?



**B.** How many qualified appointments did you personally book per week?



**C.** Did you generate your own leads or were leads provided to you?



**D.** What industries have you cold-called?



**E.** What CRM, diallers, LinkedIn and
 prospecting tools have you used?



**F.** Tell us about one campaign where you were personally responsible for generating appointments from cold prospects.



**G.** What was your previous base salary and commission structure?



**H.** If we gave you the target of finding 10 large warehouses in Western Sydney that may want a vending service, explain exactly how you would find the decision-maker and approach them.



Applications that do not answer these questions and provide the requested recording will not be considered.



We are looking for two experienced, commercially minded outbound salespeople, not dozens of average applicants.

title: Senior Social Media Manager with Focus on Video Editing and LinkedIN (Full-Time, Permanent)
description:
We are looking for an experienced social media growth professional to take ownership of our social media presence and be directly responsible for growing our audience, engagement and ultimately generating business opportunities.

This is not a role for someone who simply schedules posts or publishes generic content. We are looking for someone with a demonstrable track record of growing social media channels, particularly LinkedIn and YouTube, with
 and Instagram being secondary priorities.



Your success in this role will be measured by the growth and performance of our channels. We expect to see consistent progress over time, and you will be given the autonomy to develop and execute the strategy needed to achieve that.



About Us

We are an established UK business that has been trading for over 25 years. Unlike many online-only companies, we are a substantial physical business with a large warehouse and office operation in the UK.



We currently operate five brands:



• 

• 

• 

• 

• 



Until recently, marketing has not been a major focus for the business, meaning there is significant opportunity for someone to build something meaningful from the ground up.



The Role

You will take ownership of our social media strategy across all five brands.

LinkedIn is our highest priority as we are primarily a B2B business, but we also want to significantly grow our YouTube presence while developing
 and Instagram into valuable supporting channels.

You will be responsible for planning, creating and managing content across all platforms while working closely with our UK office team to create engaging, product-focused content.



A major part of the role will involve developing ideas and scripts for YouTube videos which can then be repurposed into shorter content for LinkedIn,
, Instagram and other platforms.



This is a management-level role. We expect you to identify opportunities, create the strategy and drive execution rather than waiting to be told what to post each day.



Your Key Responsibilities



• Grow followers across all social media channels.

• Increase engagement and reach through high-quality content.

• Grow our LinkedIn pages into industry-leading resources.

• Develop and grow our YouTube channel with long-form and short-form content.

• Produce engaging social media posts, graphics and videos.

• Create video scripts, content calendars and campaign ideas.

• Work closely with our UK office team to organise and capture content.

• Develop our
 marketing strategy alongside our social media activity.

• Monitor analytics and continually improve performance.



Performance Expectations



This is a results-based role.



You will be judged on measurable improvements including (but not limited to):

• Growth in LinkedIn followers and engagement.

• Growth in YouTube subscribers, watch time and views.

• Increased engagement across
 and Instagram.

• Website traffic generated from social media.

• Lead generation and business impact where applicable.

• Overall improvement of our online presence.



We understand that meaningful growth takes time, but we do expect to see consistent progress. If you're someone who has repeatedly grown social media channels and can demonstrate those results, we'd love to hear from you.

If your experience is mainly scheduling posts or maintaining existing accounts without significant growth, this role is unlikely to be a good fit.



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:

• A proven history of growing LinkedIn pages and YouTube channels.

• Strong content strategy skills.

• Excellent copywriting ability.

• Professional video editing skills.

• Experience creating content that generates genuine engagement.

• The ability to analyse performance data and improve results.

• Confidence working independently and taking ownership.

• A willingness to learn our products and industry in depth.



When applying, please include examples of social media accounts you have personally grown and explain your specific contribution to those results. We are particularly interested in measurable growth rather than simply content creation.



Working Hours

This is a full-time position.

Working hours are:

Monday to Friday

09:00 – 17:30 UK time (GMT/BST)

30-minute lunch break

As you'll be working closely with our UK-based office staff, these hours are essential.

This is not a freelance or part-time position.



Salary & Benefits

$6.82 per hour (approximately $1,200 per month, based on an average of 176 working hours).

Monthly pay varies depending on the number of working days.

Examples:

• 20 working days (160 hours): approximately $1091.20

• 23 working days (184 hours): approximately $1,254.88



Payment is made weekly via Wise every Friday.



Although this is a remote role, we treat our remote team members as part of our UK office.



Benefits include:

• Paid leave for all UK public/bank holidays.

• Small cash bonuses or equivalent rewards whenever the company provides team lunches or staff rewards that remote employees cannot attend.

• Long-term career progression within a growing marketing department.



Career Progression

Our goal over the next 12 months is to build a dedicated marketing team.

The highest-performing person in this role will have the opportunity to progress into a management position leading other marketing team members as the department expands.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY

• IF YOU ARE AN AGENCY

• IF YOU ARE LOOKING TO WORK PART TIME WHILE WORKING WITH OTHER CLIENTS

• You do not have significant experience in achieving results.

• You prefer simply scheduling posts rather than driving measurable growth.

• You are not looking for a long-term career opportunity.



We are looking for someone who wants to build something significant over the coming years and become a key member of our business.

title: Video Editor for E-commerce Meta Ads
description:
# Video Editor for E-commerce Meta Ads



We are looking for a creative, performance-focused Video Editor to create high-performing video ads for
 and Instagram.



This is a full-time, long-term position.



## Responsibilities



* Edit performance-focused video ads for Meta platforms.

* Turn scripts, briefs and references into engaging video creatives.

* Follow provided scripts while bringing strong creative judgment and execution.

* Create compelling hooks within the first 1–3 seconds.

* Edit both short-form and long-form ads, up to approximately 5 minutes.

* Create variations of hooks, pacing, captions and endings.

* Add captions, text animations, sound effects, music and voiceovers.

* Work with raw footage, UGC, product footage and AI-generated assets.

* Use tools such as ElevenLabs, HeyGen and other AI tools.

* Continuously improve creatives based on feedback and performance.

* Communicate proactively whenever instructions or assets are unclear.

* Track creative progress in a shared Google Sheet.

* All video ads will be edited in Spanish.

* Make sure voiceovers, captions, on-screen text, visuals and pacing are correctly aligned with the Spanish script.

* Every visual should match the message of the script/voice-over.

* English references may be provided for visual or creative guidance, but the final ad must always be fully edited in Spanish.



## Requirements



* 2–3+ years of video editing experience.

* Experience editing paid ads, preferably for e-commerce.

* Strong understanding of Meta /
 / Instagram advertising creatives.

* Strong creative judgment: you should know how to choose visuals, pacing, music, hooks and editing decisions that make an ad more engaging.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to choose the right visuals from a provided clip library without needing every editing decision explained.

* Ability to follow scripts closely without needing every editing decision explained.

* Good understanding of both short-form and long-form performance ads.

* Ability to work comfortably with Spanish-language scripts, voiceovers, captions and on-screen text.

* Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software.

* Familiarity with ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar AI tools.

* Reliable, organized and proactive.

* Strong willingness to learn, improve and apply feedback quickly.

* Review your own work carefully before submitting.



## Workload



Approximately 10 video creatives per week.



## Pay



Depends on experience and skill level.



The rate may increase over time depending on:



* The quality of your creatives.

* Your creative judgment and ability to make strong editing decisions.

* Reliability and consistency.

* Speed and efficiency.

* Ability to follow feedback and improve.

* Willingness to learn and develop.

* Overall performance and value brought to the team.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the role. Strong performance will be rewarded.



## Creative Test



Shortlisted candidates will complete a 45-second creative test before moving forward.



I will provide:



* Raw footage

* One script

* Simple guidelines



Your task will be to create one 45-second Meta ad in Spanish using the provided material.



This test is specifically to evaluate your creative judgment, so you are free to d
 the pacing, hook execution, on-screen text, music and overall editing style.



All voiceovers, captions, on-screen text, visuals and timing must be correctly aligned with the Spanish script.



No revisions will be required for the test.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your experience editing Meta / e-commerce ads.

3. 3–5 examples of your best performance ads.

4. The software and AI tools you use.

5. Your current weekly availability.

6. Your experience working with Spanish-language content.

title: Meta Media Buyer - Med Spa Lead Generation
description:

The job put simply: look at the ad accounts, work out which ads are performing, and tell our graphic designer and video editor what to make more of.



Day To Day Responsibilities:



1. D
 what creative gets made — angles, hooks, offers and formats — based on what's actually winning in the accounts

Look at a winning ad, work out which single element made it win, and build variations off that instead of starting over

Read every ad account daily, update leads and CPL in ClickUp, and flag accounts drifting above KPI before they waste spend

 pricing exact, claims accurate, compliance clean — then upload it

title: Instagram Carousel Copywriter
description:
# Instagram carousel copywriter 



We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more.



**This role is carousels. That's it.** Not
 sequences. Not landing pages. Not blogs. Not single-image posts with a clever caption. We're hiring someone who specializes in multi-slide Instagram carousels and has the receipts to prove it.



Carousels are their own format with their own rules. Slide one has to earn slide two, slide two has to earn slide three, every break is a decision, and the last slide has to convert attention you spent nine slides building. Writing one good line is not the job. Holding a reader across ten of them is.



## The job



Daily carousels for Bruno. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post.



- Daily carousels in Bruno's voice, hook slide through CTA slide

- Structure that holds the swipe: one idea per slide, breaks that pull, no dead middle

- Hooks that stop the scroll, closing slides that get DMs

- QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines

- Brief the designers so slide copy and slide design aren't fighting each other

- Track swipe-through, saves, shares, and DMs — what hits, what flops, what gets flagged — and fix the system off it

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic



Reels may come later once you've got the voice down, but carousels are the job and carousels are what we'll judge the work on.



## Who we want



Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs.



You should have:



- **A carousel portfolio.** Actual multi-slide posts you wrote, ideally for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement. Send slides, not tweets.

- **Run an actual Instagram account day to day.** You've watched your own carousels save and die, and you can explain why.

- **Copy you'd defend.** You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it.

- **A marketer's eye.** Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell.

- **AI already in your workflow.** You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you.



Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice.



## Who we're not looking for



Being direct so nobody wastes a day on the task:



- *
 marketers.** Sequences are a real craft. It isn't this one.

- **Single-slide / static post writers.** One graphic and a caption is a different skill.

- **Landing page, blog, SEO, or ad copywriters** looking to cross over into social.

- **Generalists** whose portfolio is mostly the above with a couple of carousels at the bottom.



If that's you, you're probably great at what you do. You're just not who we're after here.



## Two things we won't budge on



The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this.



Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday.



## How to apply



No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way.



**1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and the carousels you've written for creators or brands.



**2. The task.**



Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile (
), research the account, and pitch 5 carousel ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts.



Example:



> Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

>

> Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays).



Part 2: Write out 2 of those 5 as full carousels, slide by slide, as many slides as the idea needs. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too.



You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over.



Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time 

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as PropStream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Application – Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

title: Online Education Platform Manager for Fast-Growing Property Investment Business
description:
We're an Australian property investment business launching an online education platform in the property investment niche. We need someone who can build this from the ground up and then run it day-to-day — not follow an existing playbook, but create one. Starts part-time with a fast transition to full-time for the right person.



What you'll be doing

- Setting up the online education platform from scratch — systems, structure, and course infrastructure

- Getting the platform fully operational: content live, enrolment/sales process running, marketing set up

- Running the platform day-to-day once established

- Helping build out course content for the property investment education offering

- Managing any staff or contributors within the education venture

- Driving enrolments/sales and hitting targets

- Bringing a strategic, structured approach to growing the platform, while staying creative in how content and offers are built



What we're looking for

- Experience building or running an online education platform, course business, or membership/learning platform is a strong bonus

- Otherwise, experience in e-commerce, digital product launches, or online business setup is highly regarded

- Strong sales or marketing experience — comfortable driving enrollments, not just producing content

- A strategic thinker who is also creative but structured in execution

- Highly detail-oriented

- Someone who can set up a business from zero and also run it well once live — both halves matter equally



What success looks like in the first 90 days

- The platform is set up and fully systemised

- Initial course content is live

- Enrollment/sales activity is underway and being tracked

- Marketing and outreach are set up and running



Hours & schedule

- Starts part-time, with a fast transition to full-time for the right candidate. Philippines-based candidates only.



How to apply — mandatory requirements

- A 2–3 minute Loom video is required for every applicant — no exceptions. Introduce yourself, walk through your relevant experience setting up or running an online business/education platform, and explain why this role is a fit for you.



Also include:

- Examples of a business, platform, or course you've helped build or launch from scratch

- Any experience with course creation, online learning platforms, or digital product sales

- Your availability and earliest start date



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Multimedia AI Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Multimedia AI Specialist to support Jumper Media’s social media and marketing content for our client accounts. You’ll help bring ideas to life through strong editing, pacing, and storytelling—creating polished videos that are on-brand, on-strategy, and ready for fast-paced publishing.



If you’re passionate about content, editing, and using AI-assisted workflows to make high-performing videos—and you want to make a visible impact inside a fast-growing digital agency—we’d love to meet you.



What You’ll Do



- Edit a high volume of short-form social videos each week, keeping pace with a busy multi-platform posting schedule

- Create content for multiple formats and channels, including:

    - TikTok / IG Reels

    - Video cutdowns and repurposed clips for Instagram

    - YouTube videos (when needed) + thumbnails

    - Simple motion/animated elements (text, overlays, transitions) when required

- Turn raw footage into engaging edits with strong hooks, pacing, and retention-focused structure

- Add and style captions/subtitles, on-screen text, and basic graphics as needed

- Use AI tools to speed up and improve production quality (e.g., captioning, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, ideation, workflow automation) while keeping edits natural and on-brand

- Follow brand guidelines and maintain consistent visual/audio quality (fonts, colors, templates, music/SFX levels)

- Deliver work quickly and consistently—balancing daily turnaround edits with occasional longer-form projects

- Quality-check everything before delivery: clean cuts, no typos in captions, correct framing, synced audio, crisp exports

- Manage overlapping deadlines while collaborating with the team via Slack/Trello/Drive



Who You Are



- 2+ years of video editing experience (social media/marketing/content editing preferred)

- A portfolio that proves you can deliver volume + speed + polish and demonstrates AI expertise

- Proficient with at least one editing tool (any is fine): Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro

- Comfortable using AI-assisted editing tools/workflows (or a strong willingness to learn and adopt them fast)

- Strong sense of timing, storytelling, trends, and what performs on short-form platforms

- Detail-obsessed—you don’t let mistakes slip through

- Able to work under tight deadlines while meeting high-quality standards

- Available during PST business hours (night shift in the Philippines)

- Reliable, self-motivated, and takes direction well



Bonus Points



- Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)

- Experience working with U.S.-based remote teams

- Familiarity with Slack, Trello, and Google Drive

- Experience using AI tools for editing (captions, transcript-based editing, audio cleanup, cutdowns, etc.)



Compensation & Schedule



- Starts at $5/hr (with opportunities for rate increases over time based on performance)

- ~30 hours/week

- Must be available during PST hours

- Independent contractor role (long-term)



How to Apply



 
 with:  



- A link to your portfolio (required) — must include AI-related examples, such as at least one video that used AI tools/workflows, plus a quick note on what AI tool(s) were used and what you used them for (e.g., captions, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, background removal, generative elements, etc.)

- A short intro and summary of your experience



Note: Applications without a portfolio that shows AI expertise (AI-assisted video example required) will not be considered.

title: Senior Full-Stack Dev (React/Node, Cloud) - AI-Native, Long-Term
description:
I'm a senior developer / CTO running a small high-end dev agency. I only take on serious, high-stakes work: no WordPress, no throwaway projects.



This is full remote, building for clients all over the world. The role itself isn't customer-facing: you work directly with me, and I deal with the clients.



I'm not looking for a freelancer for a month or two. I want someone long-term who becomes part of the company and actually builds something interesting with me. Real work, done properly, never rushed or half-baked.



WHAT THE ROLE LOOKS LIKE

- Fully AI-driven. Day to day is more about orchestrating AI agents (Claude, Codex, and similar), reading and reviewing their code, and holding the line on quality (including blocking a merge when the output isn't good enough) than hand-writing everything yourself.

- Building genuinely cool things and going deep on automation.

- Stacks are mostly React and Node, plus GCP and Cloudflare.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Strong engineering practices. You know what good code and good architecture look like.

- Real infra / cloud experience (GCP, Cloudflare, CI/CD, deployments).

- Comfortable driving AI agents daily, and rigorous about reviewing their output.

- Fluent English, reliable, autonomous.



SETUP

- Full remote, full time. Work whenever you want, as long as the work gets done.

- $2,000/month, plus I cover a Claude Code Max plan for you.

- You use your own machine for now (we can look at hardware later).

- Long-term, with room to grow and become part of the company.



HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter needed, I don't care about that. Just include a link to a short 3-5 minute video: camera on so I can see you, screen-share your setup, and walk me through how you work day to day, how you review code, and how you manage your AI agents. Show me some recent things you've built or tested that you think are cool. Keep it simple and real, not polished or scripted. And tell me what's caught your eye in GenAI lately: a model that impressed you, a side project, an article, an experiment, anything you got genuinely excited about.

title: Client Success & Growth Executive
description:
Location: Remote

Company: LMR Financial Services

Salary: $400 USD per month, plus performance-based incentives

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm (UK Time)



About LMR Financial Services



At LMR Financial Services, we're more than a UK mortgage and insurance brokerage. We're building a business with ambitious growth plans, and we're looking for people who want to grow alongside us.



We're a close-knit, ambitious team that believes exceptional customer service starts with exceptional people. Every conversation with a client matters, and we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys speaking with people, building relationships, and creating a fantastic first impression.



This isn't just another remote job. We're looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our journey, contribute ideas, take ownership of their work, and develop into new roles as the business continues to expand.



If you're looking for a company where your hard work will be recognised and rewarded, we'd love to hear from you.



The Opportunity



You'll be the first point of contact for clients who have already expressed an interest in our services through our online marketing campaigns.



These are warm leads, not cold calls.



Your role is to build genuine relationships with prospective clients, understand their circumstances, qualify their enquiry, and arrange an appointment with one of our Mortgage & Protection Advisers.



We're not looking for someone who simply follows a script.



We're looking for someone who can hold natural conversations, bring positive energy to every call, make people feel comfortable, and represent our business with professionalism and enthusiasm.



As LMR Financial Services grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress into more senior positions within the business.



Key Responsibilities



* Contact warm mortgage and insurance enquiries by telephone.

* Build genuine relationships with prospective clients.

* Create an outstanding first impression of LMR Financial Services.

* Qualify clients by gathering key information, including:



  * Employment status

  * Annual income

  * Residency status

  * Credit history

* Book appointments for our Mortgage & Protection Advisers.

* Update our CRM accurately after every conversation.

* Follow up with prospective clients when required.

* Attend the daily team meeting at 9:00am (UK time).

* Work towards individual and team performance targets.

* Continuously improve your communication skills and product knowledge.



Who We're Looking For



This role is perfect for someone who:



* Loves speaking with people.

* Has a naturally positive personality and brings energy to every conversation.

* Builds trust and rapport quickly.

* Makes customers feel comfortable.

* Is an excellent communicator with fluent spoken English.

* Takes pride in their work.

* Is organised, reliable and self-motivated.

* Enjoys learning and developing new skills.

* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Wants to grow with a business rather than simply work for one.

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop into future leadership or operational roles.



Previous experience in appointment setting, telesales, customer service, sales, lead generation or call centres is beneficial, but not essential.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn't simply about making calls.



You'll be successful if you:



* Build genuine relationships with clients.

* Create a positive customer experience.

* Qualify enquiries accurately.

* Book high-quality appointments.

* Meet and exceed performance targets.

* Represent LMR Financial Services professionally.

* Show initiative and continuously look for ways to improve.



Performance Expectations



During your probationary period, you'll be expected to:



* Generate a minimum of 15 fully qualified appointments per month.

* Maintain accurate CRM records.

* Deliver excellent customer service.

* Attend daily team meetings.

* Meet agreed quality standards.



Quality is just as important as quantity. We value meaningful conversations that create an excellent customer experience.



Career Progression



We're hiring for potential, not just experience.



This role is designed for someone who wants to build a long-term career within our business.



As LMR Financial Services continues to grow, there will be opportunities to progress into areas such as:



* Team Leadership

* Operations

* Training & Coaching

* Recruitment

* Marketing

* Business Development

* Process Improvement



We regularly review performance and recognise those who consistently deliver excellent results.



High-performing team members will have opportunities for:



* Performance-based incentives.

* Salary reviews based on performance and contribution.

* Increased responsibilities.

* Career progression into senior positions as the company grows.

title: Creative & Brand Manager for a Growing E-Commerce Brand
description:
Creative & Brand Manager

Help shape the identity, content and future growth of NORDMOND.



We are looking for a creative professional who wants to help build a recognizable brand - not simply complete design tasks.



Who We Are

NORDMOND is a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating premium, functional home-care products. We currently sell mainly through Amazon US and Canada and are preparing to expand our product line, website, social presence and external sales channels.

We are at a defining stage: the products and opportunities exist, but the brand needs a stronger creative identity and a consistent voice. Our goal is to turn NORDMOND into a trusted, recognizable consumer brand - not another generic Amazon product.



The Opportunity

You will work closely with the CEO and have real influence over what NORDMOND becomes. You will help establish the creative direction, bring original ideas and connect every customer-facing touchpoint into one clear brand experience.



This Role Is For You If

• You are a creative professional with strong visual judgment, taste and a clear point of view.

• You want to help shape a growing brand rather than maintain a finished corporate system.

• You can think strategically and also execute hands-on when needed.

• You see branding, content, social media and e-commerce as one connected customer experience.

• You understand that strong creative work should build trust, explain the product and support sales growth.

• You naturally bring ideas, spot opportunities and improve work without waiting for detailed instructions.

• You can lead creators, influencers and freelancers through clear briefs and constructive feedback.

• You actively use AI for research, ideation and content production, adding strong human judgment and brand consistency.

• You want to commit to one brand, take ownership and grow with the company over the long term.

 

This Role Is Not For You If

• You are looking only for a graphic design production role or a fixed list of tasks.

• You rely on templates or generic AI output and struggle to create original work.

• You prefer presenting ideas but avoid execution, revisions and follow-through.

• You see social media mainly as scheduling posts or increasing vanity metrics.

• You need constant step-by-step direction or wait to be told what to do next.

• You are managing several full-time clients and can only treat NORDMOND as a side project.

• You do not have a relevant portfolio that clearly shows your own contribution.



What You Will Own

The detailed responsibilities, priorities and deliverables will be agreed through a 30/60/90-day plan. At a high level, you will own:

• Brand identity and overall creative direction.

• Photo, video and social media content strategy.

• Influencer, creator and UGC collaborations.

• Creative direction for Amazon, Shopify, packaging and product launches.

• Coordination of designers, editors, photographers and other creative specialists.

• New creative and branding ideas that can strengthen trust and support business growth.

What We Expect

• At least 3 years of relevant creative, brand, content or e-commerce experience.

• A strong portfolio, ideally including consumer, DTC or product-based brands.

• Strong written and spoken English and professional remote communication.

• Confidence with design, video and current AI tools, plus strong judgment of production quality.

• Reliability, attention to detail, openness to feedback and ownership of outcomes.

Role Structure

• Full-time, fully remote and intended as a long-term position.

• Reliable overlap with EEST working hours for collaboration.

• High autonomy, clear priorities and direct collaboration with the CEO.

• Compensation based on experience, portfolio and demonstrated ownership.



How to Apply

• A short introduction explaining why this role and NORDMOND interest you.

• Your portfolio and three relevant projects, including your exact contribution.

• Your location, time zone, availability and compensation expectations.

Include the word "clarity" in your application. Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution, and everything we put out, including our short-form video, is expected to feel as considered as the brands we build.



We're looking for a skilled short-form video editor to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. You'll receive a brief, brand deliverables, and a kick-off call, then own the edit from start to finish. Part of the work involves editing AI-generated footage (e.g. Kling, Runway) into finished, brand-grade reels, so comfort working with generated clips, and the imperfections that come with them, is essential.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started editing and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive project briefs via online meeting and written documentation, then independently own full short-form edits

- Cut vertical (9:16) reels for a range of brand contexts, including narrative pieces, product content, studio content, and more

- Design and animate captions and titles in the brand's typeface, kinetic typography that looks intentional rather than default auto-caption

- Handle sound design: choose and cut music, sync cuts to the beat, and time drops and hits so the edit lands emotionally

- Colour grade and unify footage from mixed sources, including AI-generated clips, into one cohesive look

- Work with AI-generated source clips: select the cleanest usable frames, cut around artefacts, and know when a clip needs regenerating

- Deliver organised, export-ready files to platform spec, and help us build reusable templates as the format matures



What This Role Is Not



This is not a role for a generalist or long-form editor. Wedding, vlog, corporate, and talking-head YouTube editing is a different craft, and we're specifically after short-form, brand-led vertical work.



It's not for CapCut-and-auto-captions editors. We care about custom, on-brand typography and real sound design, not templated defaults.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong portfolio of published short-form vertical work (Reels / TikTok / Shorts) that shows real craft. Brand or product content preferred, not personal vlogs. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level in either After Effects or Premiere Pro, and strong in the other. After Effects capability matters, because our caption and title work lives there

- Motion graphics and kinetic typography. You can animate text in a brand typeface and make it feel designed

- Genuine sound-design instinct. Cutting music to the beat and making a drop land is non-negotiable, it's where a good reel becomes a great one

- Colour grading, the ability to take mismatched clips and unify them into a single, cohesive look

- Comfortable editing AI-generated footage and working around its quirks

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- Hands-on experience with AI video tools (Kling, Runway, or similar)

- A templated, systematic way of working. You document your process, because we intend to make our best formats repeatable

- Familiarity with Figma and working from brand deliverables

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and all relevant brand deliverables. From there, you own the edit. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your portfolio, links to published, live short-form work only. No unlisted mockups or screenshots of editor views. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one full reel edited from a real brief, before we move forward. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: UX/UI Web Designer
description:
*Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig / Part-time / Full-time*

Boutique Branding Studio — Netherlands



---



*About the Role*



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand strategy, identity, and digital execution. The websites we build are not afterthoughts to a brand project, they are the brand, made interactive.



We're looking for a Web Designer who leads with structure and ends with craft. Someone who opens a new project by thinking about pages, flows, and systems, not colours and typefaces. The visual execution matters enormously, but it comes last.



You'll join a small team on a gig basis, with a clear path to part-time and full-time for the right person. You'll own the design process from sitemap to hand-off, working alongside our brand leads and Webflow developer.



---



*Who You Are*



Before you are a designer, you are a systems thinker. You map information before you design screens. You wireframe to solve problems, not to sketch rough ideas. When you look at a website brief, your first instinct is to ask: what does this site need to do, how should it be structured, and how will someone move through it?



You understand the web as a medium, not a canvas. You think about scroll behaviour, states, responsiveness, and hierarchy the way a developer thinks about logic: it either works or it doesn't.



You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives.



---



*What You'll Do*



— Translate briefs and brand strategy into sitemaps and content architecture before a single screen is designed

— Build wireframes that define structure, hierarchy, and user flow with enough detail that they could be critiqued and approved on their own

— Design full website concepts in Figma, desktop and mobile, using consistent components and a system-first approach

— Build and maintain design systems and component libraries that scale across pages and projects

— Hand off clean, structured Figma files to our Webflow developer with zero ambiguity

— Work closely with brand leads from briefing through to final design, contributing to conceptual direction where needed



---



*What We're Not Looking For*



A graphic designer who can also do web. Someone who jumps to visual design before the structure is solved. Someone who designs pages in isolation without thinking about the system they belong to. Someone who needs direction at every step.



If your portfolio is full of beautiful screens with no evidence of the thinking behind them, this is not the right role.



---



*What We're Looking For*



Required:

— 5+ years specialising in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design

— A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time

— Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief

— Wireframes that stand on their own — detailed, annotated, and used as a real tool for alignment

— Expert Figma skills: components, auto layout, variants, design systems, developer hand-off

— A systems mindset — you think in reusable parts, not one-off pages

— Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behaviour, mobile-first thinking, interactive states

— Portfolio of live marketing and corporate websites that show process, not just output

— Clear, proactive communicator in English



Nice to have:

— Familiarity with Webflow, knowing how your designs will be built makes you a better designer

— Experience building or maintaining full design systems across multiple projects

— Conceptual contribution to brand and campaign work that feeds into web

— Micro-interaction or animation thinking at the wireframe stage



---



*How We Work Together*



A project starts with a briefing — sometimes strategic, sometimes a brand deep-dive, often both. From there, you lead: sitemap first, wireframes second, visual design third. You'll work closely with our brand leads and Webflow developer at each stage. Client communication stays with the studio. Your job is to design something that works and looks considered, then hand it off clearly.



We're a small team. We don't micromanage, and we don't chase. We expect you to ask the right questions early, raise blockers when they appear, and deliver work that doesn't need explaining.



---



*Compensation*



Hourly rate is based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person.



This starts as a gig engagement. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



---



*How to Apply*



Send us:



— Your portfolio — live websites only. We're not interested in Dribbble shots, unsolicited redesigns, or graphic design work. Show us websites you shipped.

— 2–3 case studies that walk us through your process: how you structured the site, what the wireframes looked like, how the final design connects back to the brief. The thinking matters as much as the output.

— A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, and your hourly rate.



*Applications without a process-driven case study will not be reviewed.*

title: Meta Ad Library Researcher (Winning Static Ads & Products)
description:
We are a direct-to-consumer beauty & skincare brand. We need a sharp researcher to spend time inside the Meta Ad Library every day, hunting for winning static (image) ads and the products behind them.



This is a research + logging role. You are our eyes in the market. You will NOT design, write copy, or launch anything. You find proven winners and document them cleanly so our team can act on them.



WHAT MAKES AN AD "WINNING"

The strongest signal is longevity + spend: ads that have been running for weeks or months, and advertisers running many variations of the same image. Long-running ads are almost always profitable ads. That's what we want you to catch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Search the Meta Ad Library daily in the beauty / skincare / cosmetics niche

Focus on STATIC image ads (not video) — this is the whole point of the role

Identify ads that have been running a long time and/or are being run in high volume

For each winner, log it in our Google Sheet: screenshot, brand/page name, product, how long it's been running, the landing page/offer, and the angle (what problem it sells against)

Identify the actual product being sold and where it appears to be sourced

Only flag TOPICAL / cosmetic products (creams, serums, roll-ons, patches, tools). Skip anything ingested (pills, powders, drinks, supplements) — we don't sell those.

Hit a daily/weekly find target we agree on



WHO THIS IS FOR



You have a good eye for marketing — you can tell a real winner from a random ad

You are patient and thorough; you'll scroll for hours and stay organized

You log everything cleanly and consistently, no sloppy entries

You understand (or can quickly learn) how to read run-dates and variations in the Ad Library

Bonus: you've done ad research / "ad swiping" for a DTC or dropshipping brand before



TOOLS



Meta Ad Library (
/ads/library)

Google Sheets

A screenshot tool



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word CARIBOU so we know you read this fully. Applications without it are deleted.

Send us ONE example of a beauty/skincare image ad you found in the Ad Library that you'd flag as a winner — the page name and why you think it's winning.

Tell us if you've done ad research before, and for what kind of brand.



HOW WE HIRE

We start with one small paid test task: find and log 10 winning static ads to our format. If your finds and logging are good, we move to an ongoing part-time arrangement. Payment is per completed, approved deliverable.

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Admin Assistant with Xero Bookkeeping Experience
description:
Hi! I’m Rona



I’m currently the Operations, Finance & HR Lead | Founder’s 2IC across Duke the Label and Velocity Digital Co, and I’m looking for a full-time Admin Assistant who will work directly under me.



One important requirement for this role is Xero experience, particularly with basic bookkeeping and reconciliations.



However, I want to make it clear that bookkeeping will not be the entirety of your role.



You’ll essentially be supporting me with the smaller day-to-day tasks that currently sit across my workload so I can spend more time focusing on higher-level finance, operations, HR, forecasting, investigations, and business management.



Your tasks may include things like:



• Assisting with Xero reconciliations and bookkeeping-related admin

• Updating spreadsheets, trackers, and internal records

• Following up on outstanding tasks or information

• Addressing straightforward concerns or coordinating them with the right person

• Scheduling meetings, calls, reminders, and recurring tasks

• Organising files, documents, and information

• Assisting with invoices, payments, and other finance admin

• Updating employee or contractor information

• Helping with onboarding and other HR-related admin

• Checking that tasks have been completed and following up where needed

• Researching information or finding solutions to operational concerns

• Preparing information I need for reports or decision-making

• General administrative and VA tasks that I delegate to you



The best way to describe the role is that you’ll be helping me take smaller day-to-day tasks off my plate.



One day, that might mean reconciling transactions in Xero. Another day, it could be updating a spreadsheet, scheduling something, following up with someone, checking an invoice, organising information, or helping me address an internal concern.



There will be variety, but these are tasks that currently sit within my own role. I’m simply starting to delegate the smaller ones so I can focus more of my time on higher-level responsibilities.



I’m not expecting you to come in and immediately take over entire areas of my role.



I’ll be assigning and overseeing your tasks, and I’m very willing to train the right person. As you become more familiar with both businesses and I become confident in your work, I’ll gradually be able to delegate more to you.



What I’m really looking for is someone I can eventually give a task to, explain what needs to happen, and trust them to run with it.



What I’m looking for:



• Must be available to work AU business hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Brisbane time / 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM PH time

• Xero experience is required

• Strong attention to detail

• Organised and comfortable managing multiple tasks

• Fast learner

• Resourceful and proactive

• Comfortable researching and trying to find a solution before immediately asking for help

• Good written communication

• Reliable and accountable

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

• Takes ownership of their work

• Comfortable with variety and wearing different hats



You don’t need to know everything.



I would much rather hire someone who learns quickly, listens carefully, asks the right questions, and genuinely wants to become dependable than someone who ticks every technical box but needs to be constantly followed up.



What’s included:



• $5 USD/hour

• Full-time role

• Salary progression based on performance

• 10 days paid vacation leave

• 5 days paid sick/emergency leave

• Paid Australian public holidays

• Bonus at the Founder’s discretion

• Hired directly by the company

• Long-term opportunity for the right person



You’ll also be joining an established Filipino team across different departments, so while you’ll be working directly under me, you won’t feel like you’re working completely on your own.



If you’re genuinely interested, please send the following through the OLJ inbox only:



A short written introduction about yourself

Your experience using Xero and what you’ve handled inside the platform

Other admin, finance, HR, operations, or VA tasks you’ve handled before

Your updated CV/resume

On a scale of 1–10, how interested are you in this role, and why? Please give me a genuine answer rather than what you think I want to hear.



From there, I’ll reach out to shortlisted applicants to arrange a call.

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Rep
description:
RED | Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.

We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to learn just as much as experience.



If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and continuously improving, we'd love to hear from you.





Important



We need someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. While we understand that many virtual assistants work with multiple clients, preference will be given to applicants who can fully commit to our team. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for people who want to grow with us: not just fill available hours.



If you're dependable, eager to learn, and consistently perform at a high level, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.





Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge.

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

* Ecommerce customer service experience is preferred but not required.





How to Apply

To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word RED at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



* What motivates you to do great work?

* Why do you want to work with our company?

* Tell us about a time you had to learn something completely new. How did you approach it?

* What do you believe makes excellent customer service?

* How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

* If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. Bonus Exercise

A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or years of experience.

title: Intake Specialist
description:
Are you ready to be a vital part of a dynamic legal team, providing invaluable support in the criminal defense field? Rose Legal Services LLC is expanding its remote team and is actively seeking a full-time Intake Specialist. Whether you're an experienced paralegal, a recent certification recipient, or someone passionate about criminal law, we want to hear from you. Prior sales experience is a plus, but more importantly, we're looking for individuals with a genuine enthusiasm for criminal defense and helping people. For this role, we are especially interested in applicants who have excelled in a Call Center, particularly if they have a demonstrated interest in the legal profession.



About Rose Legal Services, LLC

Rose Legal Services LLC, based in St. Louis, MO, is a thriving criminal defense and DWI law firm. Our team focuses solely on representing individuals facing charges, arrests, or investigations. We also handle related civil litigation like expungements, driver’s license cases, and orders of protection. Our primary goal is securing the best outcomes for our clients while ensuring an exceptional client experience. Above all, we believe in SECOND CHANCES. Our hiring decisions are based on our CORE VALUES:



Uncompromising Integrity: Genuine integrity in every action, no Saul Goodman aspirations.

Care: Deep concern for our clients, their legal matters, our team, and office policies.

Teamwork: Prioritizing client and firm interests over personal agendas.

Growth Mindset: Continuous improvement, education, and adaptation to new technology.

Relentless Focus on Client Experience: We want our clients to have an outstanding experience working with us.



Responsibilities:

As an Intake Specialist, you play a crucial role as the first point of contact with the firm, shaping the initial impressions for potential clients. Your responsibilities include:

• Answering inbound calls and conducting initial intakes for prospective clients.

• Responding to lead inquiries via telephone calls,
s, text messages, online form submissions, and chat widget engagements.

• Efficiently managing and utilizing our lead intake software.

• Drafting and sending Legal Services Agreements, Automatic Payment Authorization Forms, and Personal Guaranty Agreements.

• Scheduling and confirming lead consultations with our attorneys.

• Maintaining regular contact and following up with pending leads.

• Participating in daily team meetings to stay informed about new policies, workflows, and priorities.

• Providing general office support and handling administrative duties as needed.



Requirements:

To excel in this role, we're looking for someone who possesses:

• Excellent proficiency in computers and technology, including Word, Excel, database software, and Outlook.

• Outstanding telephone etiquette and communication skills.

• Exceptional data entry capabilities with a keen eye for detail.

• A professional demeanor and excellent people skills.

• Good time management and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

• The ability to work well independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

• Flexibility, initiative, good judgment, and discretion.

• Preferred: Law school graduates or Juris Doctor (JD) degree holders.



Rose Legal Services is committed to providing training for the right candidate, regardless of prior experience. We highly appreciate individuals who bring a passion for excellence, a positive attitude, and a willingness to contribute to a collaborative team environment. If you're reliable, energetic, and eager to contribute to a positive client experience, we encourage you to apply.

title: Alphacam Programmer
