title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST - Shopify
description:
CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST — Shopify / eCommerce

Part-Time (15-20h/week)  |  Remote  |  Long-term



"We don't just solve problems — we make customers feel heard, helped, and happy."



ABOUT US



We run a growing group of Shopify stores across Europe — currently five and we work alongside partner stores in other European markets. Our team is small, fully remote, and runs on clear written processes.



We are looking for one Customer Support Specialist to own the inbox across all our stores. This is a long-term position. As we open more stores, this role grows with us in hours, in responsibility, and in pay.



THE ONE THING THAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT — READ THIS



Our customers do NOT write in English.

They write in Finnish, Dutch, German, Spanish and Danish.



You are not expected to speak any of those languages. Nobody on our team does either.

You will use DeepL to translate every incoming
 into English/your language, d
 what to do using our written SOPs, write your reply in English, and translate it back. We will train you on this workflow it is simple and it works.



What this means for you:

  - You need JUDGEMENT, not languages. Knowing when to refund, when to resend, when to escalate — that is the job.

  - You need to be careful. A translated reply that is technically correct but tonally cold still loses a customer.

  - If you are uncomfortable working with text you cannot read directly, this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



  Zoho Mail            — where all customer
s arrive

  Shopify Admin    — orders, refunds, tracking

  DeepL                 — translation, every single ticket

  Google Sheets    — daily reporting and tracking

  WhatsApp           — team communication





REQUIREMENTS



MUST — Fluent written English (C1 or above). Your writing IS the product.

MUST — Minimum 2 years in customer support. eCommerce strongly preferred.

MUST — Comfortable using translation tools daily and working in languages you do not speak.

MUST — Able to answer every ticket within 24 hours, including a check on weekends.

MUST — Available for one weekly team call.

MUST — Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

MUST — Experience with Klarna chargebacks and disputes (buy-now-pay-later). Klarna is a common payment method in our markets, and you must know how to respond to a dispute, gather the right evidence and meet the deadline.



PREFERRED — Experience with Shopify.

PREFERRED — Experience with dropshipping fulfilment (long shipping times, tracking issues, "where is my order").

PREFERRED — Experience with a helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar).

PREFERRED — Experience supporting European customers.





WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



  - Translate, read and answer every incoming customer
 across all stores, within the 24-hour SLA.

  - Resolve the usual cases using our SOPs: refunds, tracking, delays, wrong item, cancellations, returns.

  - Escalate what you should not d
 alone — with the order number, the customer's message translated, and your recommendation. Never escalate empty-handed.

  - Send a short end-of-day report: how many
s, what the top issues were, what is still open and why.

  - Flag patterns. If eight people ask the same thing this week, that is a broken product page or a broken process — and we want to know.

  - Keep the tracking sheet up to date.





WHAT WE OFFER



  USD 4.00/hour, 15-20 hours per week.

  Performance bonus on top — paid monthly, based on response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction. We will show you the exact numbers before you start, so you always know what you are being measured on.

  Paid two-week trial before we both commit.

  Written SOPs and video training for every process. You will not be guessing.

  Direct access to the owner during your first weeks.

  Real growth: we are opening more stores. Hours and pay grow with the workload.

  Fully remote, flexible within the 24-hour SLA.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



To confirm you actually read this post, start your application with the word "CLARITY" followed by your introduction.

Applications without this word will not be read.



HOW TO APPLY



Start with the secret word, then a short introduction, then answer these:



  1. Describe your most relevant customer support experience. Be specific about the product, the market and the volume.



  2. Which helpdesk or
 tools have you used, and for how long?



  3. A customer writes in Spanish, angry, demanding a full refund on an order that shipped 19 days ago and is still in transit. Our policy allows refunds only after 30 days. Write your actual reply to that customer, in English.

     (We want to see how you write, not a summary of what you would do.)



  4. Have you ever used DeepL or Google Translate as part of your daily job?

     Tell us how.



  5. What is your timezone and what hours per day can you commit to?



We read every application that includes the secret word. Thank you.

title: Real Estate Outbound Prospecting & Buyer Acquisition Specialist
description:
Real Estate Outbound Prospecting & Buyer Acquisition Specialist

Part-Time | 25–30 Hours Per Week | Remote | Philippines

We are looking for a highly motivated Real Estate Outbound Prospecting & Buyer Acquisition Specialist for a very specific mission:

Help us find the buyer for a unique $2M Texas estate.

This is NOT a traditional customer service VA position.

This is an outbound sales, research, list-building, cold-calling, and social prospecting role.

We already have the property.

We already have professional photos, videos, marketing materials, and an active real estate listing.

Your job is to help us proactively find the people who could lead us to the buyer.

The Property

The property is a unique private estate located approximately one hour east of Dallas, Texas.

It includes:

Approximately 40 acres

Nearly 6,000 square feet under roof

4,500+ square feet under air

Large barn

Pond

Long private driveway

Privacy and acreage

High-end custom home

Outside city limits

This is not a typical subdivision home, which means we don't want to simply put it online and wait.

We want to actively hunt for the buyer.

Your Mission

Every day, your job is to answer:

Who can we contact today who could potentially lead us to the buyer?

You will research, build lists, make outbound calls, send
s and DMs, follow up with contacts, distribute property information, and help create additional exposure for the estate.

A major part of the position will involve contacting real estate agents and brokers who may already have clients looking for this type of property.

What You'll Do

Build Highly Targeted Prospect Lists

We do NOT want random lists of thousands of Realtors.

We want intelligent lists.

For example:

Agents who recently represented buyers of $1M–$3M properties

Agents who have sold acreage properties

Luxury real estate agents

Ranch and land specialists

Agents representing buyers moving outside Dallas

Agents working in communities where potential buyers may currently live

Brokerage owners and managing brokers

Luxury brokerage teams

Relocation specialists

Other professionals who may have relationships with potential buyers

You'll research these people and build an organized prospecting database including phone numbers,
s, social profiles, brokerage information, and why each person is relevant.

Cold Calling

A significant part of your day will involve making outbound calls.

You may call:

Real estate agents

Brokers

Brokerage offices

Referral partners

Other targeted prospects

The goal isn't to pressure anyone.

The goal is to create conversations.

You should be comfortable saying something like:

"I'm reaching out because we have a unique 40-acre estate available outside Dallas, and based on the types of properties you work with, I wanted to see if you have any buyers who might be looking for something like this."

Then you'll know how to continue the conversation naturally.

Social Media Prospecting

You will also help us create exposure through:


 Groups

Instagram

LinkedIn

TikTok

Direct messages

Real estate communities

Local groups

Business-owner communities

Other relevant online communities

We want someone who understands that social media isn't only about posting.

It's also a massive prospecting database.

Follow-Up

We don't want someone making one call and forgetting about the prospect.

You will maintain an organized follow-up system showing:

Who was contacted → What happened → What was sent → Next action → Follow-up date

If an agent says:

"I might have someone. Send me the property."

That becomes an opportunity that needs to be properly tracked and followed up.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience with US real estate is strongly preferred.

Experience as a:

Real Estate ISA

Real Estate Cold Caller

Appointment Setter

Real Estate VA

Lead Generation Specialist

Acquisition Specialist

List Builder

Social Media Prospector

would be especially valuable.

You should be comfortable speaking English with American professionals on the phone.

You must also be resourceful.

We don't want someone who needs to be handed a new call list every morning.

We want someone who can eventually say:

"I found another 137 agents who have represented acreage buyers in this price range, and I'm building that list now."

That's the mindset we're looking for.

You Must Be Comfortable With

Cold calling every day.

Researching prospects.

Building lists.

Talking to American real estate agents and brokers.

Following up.

Using a CRM or spreadsheet.

Sending
s and DMs.

Researching social media.

Learning about one property extremely well.

Trying new prospecting angles when something isn't working.

Being measured by your activity AND the opportunities you create.

How We'll Measure Success

We will track things such as:

Targeted prospects added

Calls attempted

Live conversations

Agents/brokers reached

Property information requested

s sent

DMs sent

Follow-ups completed

Referrals generated

Potential buyers identified

Buyer inquiries generated

Showings created

The ultimate goal is simple:

Help us find the person who buys this property.

Important

This position is focused on marketing, research, prospecting, outreach, and lead generation.

You will not be acting as the licensed Texas real estate agent or negotiating real estate transactions.

Our licensed real estate professionals will handle activities requiring a real estate license.

How to Apply

Please do NOT send us a generic copy-and-paste application.

Start your application with the words:

FIND THE BUYER

Then answer these questions:

Tell us about your experience cold calling for US real estate companies or agents.

Approximately how many outbound calls have you made in previous roles?

What experience do you have building your own prospecting lists?

What tools have you used for real estate research, list building, skip tracing, CRM, or lead generation?

Have you cold called US Realtors or brokers before?

What experience do you have with
, LinkedIn, Instagram,
 Groups, or social media prospecting?

If we gave you a $2M, 40-acre estate outside Dallas and told you to find the buyer, what are the first THREE prospect lists you would build?

Send a short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a Texas Realtor about our property.

Bonus: If you really want to stand out, spend 15–20 minutes doing research and include five real estate agents or brokers you would contact first and explain why you chose them.

We are looking for someone who enjoys the hunt.

Someone who likes researching.

Someone who isn't afraid of the phone.

Someone who can turn the internet into a prospecting database.

Someone who understands that somewhere out there is the person who wants this property.

Your job is to help us find them.
